Gears & Beers.name: Gears & Beers
Gears & Beers.description: Hometown: Seattle If your Art Car, Mutant Vehicle or Mobility device needs repairs, welding or diagnosis, we’re your on-playa repair camp happy to try and get you safely burning again! We have a curated inventory of often-needed parts in-stock plus raw materials, specialty tools and field experience, we’ll fix your clapped out rig and get you back on playa for everyone to enjoy! Repair Shop is ope

Gender Blender.name: Gender Blender
Gender Blender.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Oakland California Welcoming home our trans, non-binary, BIPOC, and gender non-conforming community on Playa! Contact

Giants Workshop Saloon.name: Giants Workshop Saloon
Giants Workshop Saloon.description: Hometown: Hudson Valley We could be anything—including a dusty saloon run by Giants, come by for our nightly Sunset Socials for a variety of offerings of music, food, and drinks! Our saloon doors are open 24 hours, stop by anytime to see if the bar is open or just to rest your weary boots. A variety of workshops will be happening throughout the week, roll on through and see what we’re up to!

Gigsville.name: Gigsville
Gigsville.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Los Angeles Gigsville embodies decades of Burning Man history, mixing a spirit of playful anarchy with a deep commitment to inclusion. Renowned for our legendary fuckery, we create a space where creativity and rebellion flourish. Here, every form of individuality is celebrated, from seasoned burners to wide-eyed newcomers. Our ethos is built on challenging norms and embracing everyone

Giraffelot.name: Giraffelot
Giraffelot.description: Hometown: San Francisco Like Lancealot, Camelot, you know?imagine walking through the dusty roads of Black Rock City and coming across a Renaissance Faire? but giraffes. Contact

Giraff\u00e8 Caff\u00e8.name: Giraffè Caffè
Giraff\u00e8 Caff\u00e8.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Atherton We blend the invigorating spirit of Burning Man with the universal love for coffee. Each day, we serve up an eclectic mix of fun, innovative coffee creations that awaken the senses and fuel the soul. From espresso-infused adventures to creamy concoctions that defy the ordinary, our camp is a haven for coffee enthusiasts and curious souls alike. Join us for a cup of joy, conne

GLAMCOCKS.name: GLAMCOCKS
GLAMCOCKS.description: Hometown: Seattle GlamCocks is a global family that was started at Burning Man, and is dedicated to creating extraordinary experiences that celebrate and encourage burner principles, GlamCockery, bringing people together to find inspiration and creativity, and to express their fabulous, authentic selves. Global Camp.name: Global Camp
Global Camp.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Ashland, OR Global Camp – Founded in 2018 to support the large amounts of new burners coming from abroad, we come together every year from all over the planet and share in joy, laughter, good times, and share common respect and consent at our home on the Playa. We have many veterans who come back year after year but also we keep the door open to anyone or possibility – If you’re a wor

Glorious Gilded Alchemy.name: Glorious Gilded Alchemy
Glorious Gilded Alchemy.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco Bay Area Back for more gloriously gilded shenanigans. IYKYK. Contact

GlouGlou Art.name: GlouGlou Art
GlouGlou Art.description: Hometown: Paris Glou Glou Art is a camp shaped by the spirit of natural wine. Open day and night, it invites you to discover artists connected to natural wine culture. Come add your touch to a collective artwork, then meet French natural winemakers over generous tastings, moments to share, listen, and learn about natural wine together. Contact

GlowMeUp.name: GlowMeUp
GlowMeUp.description: Hometown: Santa Cruz, California Come as you are and leave more luminous than you arrived. We are a consent-forward glow-up lounge offering UV body painting, a 24/7 costume repair station, and the Grandma’s Letters Archive, a living collection of real stories about the fabulous women who came before us. Glowskull Asylum Int\u2019l.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Santa Cruz Glowskull Asylum Int’l brings extreme metal radical inclusion to the playa. Are you craving some good headbanging and want to meet exotic misfits from random places all over the world? Gnometopia.name: Gnometopia
Gnometopia.description: Hometown: Oakland Stop by any afternoon to partake in some Gnometivities: Sing some Gnome songs Hear a Gnome talk Become a Gnome! Get a Gnome massage while listening to Gnome harp Trade Gnome outfits Complete a Gnome Quest Join us for Gnome Night on Thursday night as we explore the playa together as a flock of Gnomes. There’s Gnome telling what will happen at Gnometopia!

Golden Gate Project.name: Golden Gate Project
Golden Gate Project.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: RENO, NV The easiest way to describe our camp is like giving directions to someone who’s never been to San Francisco – look for the Golden Gate Bridge. At Burning Man, our camp is anchored by a 60-foot-long, 26-foot-tall replica of the Golden Gate Bridge, making it one of the most recognizable landmarks on the playa. Contact

Good Question.name: Good Question
Good Question.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: san francisco What can you expect from our camp? Good Question! Stop by our shady oasis to deepen your connection with your friends and loved ones, or meet a new friend entirely in a cozy, intimate atmosphere. You’ll leave feeling more connected to others, and having formed a deeper connection with yourself. Come by in the afternoon when we will be serving tea, Dosas (Indian breakfast

Grateful Burners.name: Grateful Burners
Grateful Burners.description: Hometown: Bay Area, CA Grateful Burners – your neighborhood pit stop. We’re serving up mid-day iced coffee and providing a high-pressure “Dust-Off” station for weary travelers. Come evening, relax in our shaded plaza for classic concert videos (i.e. Marley, Dead, Talking Heads, Pink Floyd etc.) and chill visuals.

Gravity.name: Gravity
Gravity.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco Camp Gravity sets sail to the heart of the sea through art installations, activities, and workshops. We make our space to be fun and engaging as well as an amazing place to dance with top notch music! Visit us! Contact

Great Vibrations.name: Great Vibrations
Great Vibrations.description: Hometown: Los Angeles Welcome to Great Vibrations. We offer 24/7 zero gravity massage chairs, daytime spa services (12pm-5pm), and a Tuesday morning sunrise dance party you will not want to miss! Contact

Gritty Garden.name: Gritty Garden
Gritty Garden.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Temecula Gritty Garden is a diversity driven camp offering a wide variety of workshops. Monday Craft Maker’s Day, Heart-to-Heart hug workshop, the Joy of Cunnilingus, and How to Give Good NO. Sunday – Saturday refreshments Bar and ice cream.

Groove Oasis.name: Groove Oasis
Groove Oasis.description: Hometown: San Francisco Groove Oasis is your refuge in the dusty desert to rest or move your body. We are hosting dance workshops and parties throughout the week so check the playa schedule and come get your groove on!

Groundhaus.name: Groundhaus
Groundhaus.description: Hometown: los angeles Groundhaus is a community camp featuring BRCGC spinning Industrial, EBM, Cold Wave, Dark Wave, Deathrock, Synthpop, RETRO, New Wave, and more.

Guano Loco Lounge.name: Guano Loco Lounge
Guano Loco Lounge.description: Hometown: Grand Junction We are a sanctuary for those who embrace the mystique of the winged wonders that navigate the darkness. Take a break from the stimulation of BRC with a visit to our Bat Cave, a sensory deprivation experience featuring sound blocking headphones and inversion tables inside a cooling cave environment. “Hang out” in our lounge equipped with surround sound, moody lighting, and

Gypsy Monkey Carnival.name: Gypsy Monkey Carnival
Gypsy Monkey Carnival.description: Hometown: GRANTS PASS Gypsy Monkey Carnival welcomes you! Come and adopt a mutant monkey, play games, and win prizes. You can ride the biggest cock on the playa. The Gypsy Monkey Carnival lounge is shady during the day and black-lighted at night, and always welcomes the weary traveler to rest and enjoy our ambiance and snark. Contact

GYST.name: GYST
GYST.description: Hometown: Sacramento WE are your burniest, neighborhood compost collector. Accepting your DRY, contaminant-free, compost daily from 3pm to 6pm. Check out our BAR and LOUNGE for drinks and trash talk! DJs and theme parties all week! Axis your Mundi at our DINKO game! Dinko Plinko is an exciting game of chance where players drop a disc or ball down a pegged board, with the outcome determined by rand

Habitat for Insanity.name: Habitat for Insanity
Habitat for Insanity.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Pittsburgh, PA We create novel burner technology and use it to bring new experiences to Black Rock City. This includes shave ice machines invented by camp members, HVAC/refrigeration adaptations for our new installation “The Tundra,” and geodesic dome design by one of the Burning Man old school masters. Contact

Hack-a-Cola.name: Hack-a-Cola
Hack-a-Cola.description: Hometown: Gerlach A visit to Hack-a-Cola is a reprieve from the heat empowered by a sampling of a wide variety of unique, handcrafted flavors of soda. Hand us a cup and we’ll mix cold carbonated water with one or more of our syrups to make a refreshing soda on the spot. We may even put a scoop of ice cream in your soda to make it a float! We tweak our recipes and invent new flavors throughout the

Hair of the Dog (HOTD).name: Hair of the Dog (HOTD)
Hair of the Dog (HOTD).description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco HOTD (Hair Of The Dog) is the longest running bar at Burning Man. We hold a piece of the original fire. HOTD gives raw performances and spontaneous acts and entertainment powered by you! HOTD is a donation bar ran on participation and gifts by burners like you! If you bring the booze and the music, then we supply the music and the booze! Contact

Hakuna Matata.name: Hakuna Matata
Hakuna Matata.description: Hometown: Miami Building art objects and art cars to light up the Playa Nocturnal Kaleidoscope! Promoting mindful and safe cruising. SLOW DOWN!!! Leave No Trace Contact

Half Baked.name: Half Baked
Half Baked.description: Hometown: Loomis Make your Official 2026 Solar Shrink-Art necklaces, earrings, keychains, bike tags & hat swag using our solar ovens. All art supplies and ovens will be provided. You COLOR it. You watch it SHRINK. You WEAR it! Walk away with some cool, commemorative, self-made swag, along with a greater understanding of the wonderful world of solar baking. Also, try our Tabletop Tug Challenge. You

Halloween Camp.name: Halloween Camp
Halloween Camp.description: Hometown: San Francisco Halloween Camp presents brings out the inner child in all of us BOO-urners, taking us back to the delights of that special day, where anybody can be anyone. Stop by our Diskull Lounge for a moment of respite, dance, and connection!

Hammered and Sickled.name: Hammered and Sickled
Hammered and Sickled.description: Hometown: Walnut Creek Hammered and Sickled is an international camp compromised of members from 30 plus countries of origins. We run a flavored Vodka bar as well as other libations and our mantra is “No one leaves our bar thirsty or walking in a straight line”. We offer the weary desert travelers an oasis where they can take a break, relax and kick their shoes off. Our campers come from different

Hang-Out, the.name: Hang-Out, the
Hang-Out, the.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: CHICO Nestled in the heart of the desert, between Home Brew and the lovely sounds of the Playa Jazz Cafe, you will find the Hangout. This will be your ultimate sanctuary for connection, creativity, and good vibes. We’re a vibrant community where artists, explorers, and free spirits come together to relax, share, ignite their inner fire and recharge their depleted bodies in our two doz

HAPPINESS AND JOY TOUR MASSAGE.description: Hometown: Chico The Happiness and Joy Tour has been all over the world spreading the message, and here at BurningMan the message is MASSAGE! Our name says it all. Come by in the middle of the day – it’s too cold at night and too hung over in the morning. Contact

Happy Hair Salon.name: Happy Hair Salon
Happy Hair Salon.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Salt Lake City Happy Hair Salon is your playa rave braid headquarters. We offer full hair extension makeovers with rave braids, bubble braids, and beard braids. We are a transformational hair salon where we showcase hair extensions as performance art. Come hang out in our antigravity chairs in the shade and watch the transformations. Burnt out? Playafied beyond belief? Come to Happy H

Happy Hanuman.name: Happy Hanuman
Happy Hanuman.description: Hometown: Fernley, NV Get ready for a wild ride with Happy Hanuman, the grooviest mutant vehicle support camp around! We’re a global crew of creative crazies, zooming in from every corner of the planet to unleash our wacky imaginations on the Playa with some seriously epic Mutant Vehicles. But wait, there’s more! Our camp is packed with fun goodies for you to explore…like our totally awesome calli

Happy Hour.name: Happy Hour
Happy Hour.description: Hometown: Sacramento Hard day on the playa? Unwind at Happy Hour, where you’ll be greeted by one of a kind refreshing spirits served with smiles! Enjoy our lounge, bar, and dance floor! Start your day with Happy Hour! Contact

Happy Seats.name: Happy Seats
Happy Seats.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Jose Decorate your bike! – seat cushions upgrades, handle bar tassels, DIY license plates, and fun time with new friends under a cool canopy

Hard as a Rock.name: Hard as a Rock
Hard as a Rock.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: El Paso A rag-tag bunch of geologists with a passion for sharing geology – including the geology of the Black Rock Desert! Join our geologists for rock talks, get creative with rock painting. Dig up your best rock puns and strike fools gold and other rockin’ gifts! Contact

Harmonic Convergence Camp.name: Harmonic Convergence Camp
Harmonic Convergence Camp.description: Hometown: Solana Beach Come by for our Welcome Pumaccinos on Monday or Farewell Pumaccinos after the Temple Burn. And if you’re looking for a good party before the Man Burn, then stop by our College Football Tailgate & Viewing Party. And we will do Group Hands-On Energy Healings on Tuesday and Thursday mornings…we can teach you how to do it. Contact

Harmonic Drift.name: Harmonic Drift
Harmonic Drift.description: Hometown: Oakland, CA Everything is an instrument. Everyone is a musician. Harmonic Drift is a mobile sound installation and open jam experience built on one belief: music belongs to everyone. Our hand-pulled trailer carries 35 gongs, found object percussion, and things that don’t have names yet. Wherever it lands, it becomes a stage for whoever shows up. When we’re not on the playa or at Center C

HAVANA NIGHTS.name: HAVANA NIGHTS
HAVANA NIGHTS.description: Hometown: Dallas, Texas Experience the essence of a vibrant Latin dance party infused with the relaxed vibe of Miami. Encircled by palm trees, our spacious, shaded dance floor beckons. Relax on our plush, elevated chill pads or sway in hammocks. Savor the night with bottomless, hand-muddled frozen mojitos as world-class DJs deliver an electrifying mix of Cuban and Latin rhythms. Immerse yourself i

HealAF.name: HealAF
HealAF.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco HealAF is your sanctuary for physical and mental recovery on the playa. We offer air cupping sessions to relieve your exhausted muscles. Simply lie down on a comfortable mat and tell us your areas of concern. While the air cups work on your physical tension, our practitioners provide soothing sound healing to wash away your mental fatigue. Stop by to heal from the inside

Healing Foot Wash Life Truth Love.name: Healing Foot Wash Life Truth Love
Healing Foot Wash Life Truth Love.description: Hometown: Benicia Life, Truth, Love: Come sit under our cooling shade canopy and get your feet washed, dried and moisturized in a tranquil and calming environment. After you have received this gift, you are invited to participate as well. We are actively building world peace and community. Contact

Heart Fusion.name: Heart Fusion
Heart Fusion.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco Heart Fusion invites you to step through its pulsating hearts into an LED-lit bell tent of reflection, mindfulness, and wonder each evening. Join us to share a relaxing beverage, and take a break in the immersive LED tent. Daytime activities throughout the week will provide additional spaces to relax under soothing sounds, stretch and recover your body, and create with y

Heart of Parkness.name: Heart of Parkness
Heart of Parkness.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco A lush green oasis in the middle of the desert, open 24 hours a day, anchored by a shade tree, carpet meadow, benches and shade. There are frisbees, chessboards, cornhole, horse shoes, chess, giant connect 4, etc. We provide electronics repair services M-Tuesday and S’mores, Shots and Soul music at sunset, W-Thursday 6-9.

HeeBeeGeeBee Healers.name: HeeBeeGeeBee Healers
HeeBeeGeeBee Healers.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Boulder We are BRC’s long-standing oasis for nurturing, grounding and healing. Stop by to hang out and chill, take a class, or to receive a healing session for the mind, body and spirit.

Hel\u2019s Diner.name: Hel’s Diner
Hel\u2019s Diner.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Gerlach Hel’s Diner is a food serving, flame throwing mutant vehicle creation that’s part of Camp Porta! Contact

Helios Hideout.name: Helios Hideout
Helios Hideout.description: Hometown: San Francisco Helios is a symbol of rebirth after hard times. It is a celebration of humanity and an invitation for us all to stand together in the challenging times ahead.

Helioz.name: Helioz
Helioz.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco At Helioz, we worship the Sun god. To honor our god, we roast delicious animals and share them with all guests. Come by in the late afternoon and evening for some tasty treats, and drink a sun-god libation.

Hello Mom!.name: Hello Mom!
Hello Mom!.description: Hometown: Southern California Celebrate the motherly or fatherly figure in your life, whoever that may be! We provide stationary, stamps, and Polaroid pictures to help you write a letter home, which we then mail from the BRC post office. We serve Mom’s apple pie and Dad’s fresh watermelon from our cozy living room to snack on while you write. Or, if writing isn’t your thing, stop by for a bit of m

Hello, Brooklyn.name: Hello, Brooklyn
Hello, Brooklyn.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: New Orleans Hello Brooklyn is a vibrant and eclectic camp where urban cool meets whimsical creativity. Our Playa neighborhood combines the charm of Brooklyn with the playful flair of a Florida Panhandle trailer park. With radical inclusion, spontaneity, and community spirit, we create a welcoming camp filled with connection, creativity, and endless surprises.

Here.name: Here
Here.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Amsterdam Here-n-Burn Drive Thru: The playa’s best breakfast sandwich and wedding drive thru Contact

Hibernaculum.name: Hibernaculum
Hibernaculum.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Grand Junction Care to get shot in the box? Get dizzy on the Bat Go Round? Savor Bat Bacon? How about a late night movie or licking your lips with Bat Blueberry Pancakes? At the Hibernaculum, serendipity rules! Know what a Hibernaculum is? Come find out. Contact

Hiburnia.name: Hiburnia
Hiburnia.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Lafayette, CA Serving delicious honey, Agave & Clove, infused hot Teas at sunrise and sunset every day. Temple Builders Drink for Free Contact

High Maintenance Entertainment.name: High Maintenance Entertainment
High Maintenance Entertainment.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Woodside, CA Somewhere between cocktail hour and the open Playa, you’ll find us – a loose constellation of builders, wanderers, and night owls hailing from the SF Bay Area, Colorado, and Australia. We gave life to Noetica in 2017 and Spark: A Burning Man Story in 2014. Now we keep the Bioluminescent Slug glowing, the drinks flowing, and our doors open to anyone who wants a ride under

HIGHKU.name: HIGHKU
HIGHKU.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Oakland, CA Push through our glowing torii gate and drop into a solar-fueled zen oasis humming on pure sun power; no roar of generators, just clean, quiet relief. Mist-kissed shade with rippling silk skies and angled tarps welcomes you to endless icy lemonade, coconut water, and a gentle train that chugs surprise gifts…cooling bandanas, glow bits, playa vitamins; straight to your dust

Hippocampus.name: Hippocampus
Hippocampus.description: Hometown: San Francisco Dust off your goggles and follow the scent of sizzle to Hippocampus, where the griddle is hot and the coffee is bottomless! We’re serving up fluffy flapjacks and radical connections to fuel your morning art adventures, so bring a plate and leave with a new playa family. Once the sun climbs high, return for Liquid Courage Karaoke to gift your wildest, dust-filtered vocals to

Hobo Camp.name: Hobo Camp
Hobo Camp.description: Hometown: Seattle Hobo Camp celebrates train-hopping culture and its community and resourcefulness. Our ambience and events include dust-bowl era music, attire, and vignettes. We are LGBTQ+ & allied. Contact

Hodge Podge.name: Hodge Podge
Hodge Podge.description: Hometown: Portland Hodge Podge – Come chill in our cafe. Come sip on espresso drink! Bring your own milk and we will make you a latte. Sporadic horse racing, doodling, and poetry fights.

Holy Babel.name: Holy Babel
Holy Babel.description: Hometown: Atlanta The Art of Such n Such is returning to BRC. This time, we are an art support camp, led by Charlie Blackcat Smith who will be working on a collaborative. fire based art piece that will serve as a memorial for Brian Doherty who met a fast fate in March. Brian literally wrote the book on Burning Man titled “This is Burning Man” in 2004. This will be a small camp centered on erecting

Homebrew 4A Homebrew.name: Homebrew 4A Homebrew
Homebrew 4A Homebrew.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Sparks We are a daytime bar with cold home brewed beverages, games and a friendly welcoming atmosphere. Enjoy a cold beer (incl. non-alcoholic), cider, mead, soda, and gluten free served daily from 10am until after dark. We have a pool table and daily events including our Playa famous pickle party! Bring your keg and we will refrigerate and tap it, or bring a bottle to share. We have

Homeslice.name: Homeslice
Homeslice.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Pasadena Drop in for a cheerful “Slice of Home” – Playa-style. Participate in our Experimental Grilled Cheese Theatre, climb the sky-high HomeSlice Tower’s inverted pyramids, or re-engineer your Playa duds and gear at our Radical Alteration clinics. Contact

Honey Pot Tea House.name: Honey Pot Tea House
Honey Pot Tea House.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Reno Come sit by our fire, enjoy a cup of tea, and enjoy a side of Burning Man that is connective, whimsical, and grounding. Sunset-sunrise tea service. Cozy fire pit. Open mic. Daily workshops. Contact

Honey Puddle.name: Honey Puddle
Honey Puddle.description: Hometown: Los Angeles Honey Puddle gives you that warm, sweet, exhilarating feeling of being enveloped by love and friendship. And music and mead and dancing and light. We’re not a quiet camp, we’re not a not-quiet camp. We’re just right…and we’ll be here when you want us. We fit like warm pajamas.

Honkers Harbor.name: Honkers Harbor
Honkers Harbor.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Portland, OR Calling all curious birds, early risers, and soulful squawkers. If you’ve been flying solo or searching for your flock, Honkers Harbor might be your next cozy nest. We’re a neighborhood sanctuary for honkers, wanderers, and high-flyers – rooted in connection, ease, and a little morning magic. Perch beneath fluttering fabrics. Start your day with a warm breakfast or a hydr

Hookahdome.name: Hookahdome
Hookahdome.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Chico Enter our silk draped, plush, cushioned, lantern-lit, air-conditioned dome to be whisked away into an oasis from the dust and heat. Let our loving attendants ensure your comfort while we serve you house made organic shisha and tea. Be entertained by a variety of intimate world music and dance performances taking place on the center carpet. Wednesday-Sunday evenings, our outdoor

Hookers & Peggers Naughty Cafe.name: Hookers & Peggers Naughty Cafe
Hookers & Peggers Naughty Cafe.description: Hometown: San Jose Come for the coffee and stay for the fun! Test your skill on our 10′ Hooker & Pegger game, or launch a dildo to drench your buddy in our dunk tank! Don’t forget to take a complimentary porno mag while you’re at it. Contact

Hooter Tooterville.name: Hooter Tooterville
Hooter Tooterville.description: Hometown: Kalama, WA Hooter Tooterville is a small art support camp dedicated to bringing fun and original art to the Playa. This year’s art installation is called “Teeny Weeny Hooter Tooter”, a fun set of 4 teeters powering two walls of musical pipes and fun things to look at.

HORIZON.name: HORIZON
HORIZON.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Fort Lauderdale Horizon was originally Inspired by the unobstructed view of the open playa – a space beyond the city’s limits, where the sun meets the mountains over the vast and empty desert – we gather to create a community built around ideals of curiosity, art, and celebration. Over the years Horizon has moved from the outer rim to plazas and to front lines of Esplanade. No matter

Horny Camp.name: Horny Camp
Horny Camp.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: New York City Horny Camp is an arts & crafts camp with a cheeky, sexy twist. Our crafts can be appropriate for everybody, from children to the childish (but pervy) at heart. Our main craft is horn making; we teach our guests to mold polymer clay to create little horns to wear on their heads. We also offer bar night events, and have an art gallery called the Gallery of Cocks that honor

Hot Noodz.name: Hot Noodz
Hot Noodz.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: West coast-pnw Stop by for diy noodles, possibly leather branding and ink stamping. Contact

HOT SHOTS.name: HOT SHOTS
HOT SHOTS.description: Hometown: Long Beach, CA Our camp is a tiny haven for those looking to immerse themselves in the beauty of the desert, fostering moments of connection and self-discovery via our golden hour photo shoots and late night treats. Join us at HOT SHOTS, where each sunset marks not just the end of a day, but the beginning of an unforgettable experience.

Hot Stuff.name: Hot Stuff
Hot Stuff.description: Hometown: London / NYC / Berlin Drinks served from dawn onward for the thirsty traveler crossing the desert sands. All manner of chilli hot and ice cool refreshments will be on offer accompanied by music from storied DJs from across the savage sands.

Hotel Lobby.name: Hotel Lobby
Hotel Lobby.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco With a lavish chandelier, bellhop service, concierge desk, a lux hotel bar, and a buzzing karaoke lounge, you’ll be treated to 5-star service and a dusty bev in a welcoming and weird Hotel Lobby. Contact

Hotline Camp.name: Hotline Camp
Hotline Camp.description: Hometown: Los Angeles Hotline invites burners to share secrets, advice, jokes, or late-night thoughts with the city. Pick up a receiver and you might hear a confession, a story, epic hold music, a stranger on the other end, or good old snark.Throughout the week we host themed daytime parties with DJs, music, and a welcoming space to gather under the shade. Stop by to get advice, leave a message, d

House of Sammich.name: House of Sammich
House of Sammich.description: Hometown: Eden, UT We serve gourmet, gluten-free, cinnamon-buttered toasted, peanut-butter and jelly sammiches. All that we ask is for you to provide us with a taste of YOUR flavor. Sing us a song…, tell us a joke…, confess a sin.., the dirtier the better. We also provide a moving cuddle puddle which is all about conscious conversations: opening up, connecting, and sharing what’s going on inside o

House Of Skin.name: House Of Skin
House Of Skin.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Spokane Welcome to “House of Skin.” Come get your daily rub down of sunscreen or grab some sunscreen and ChapStick to go on your next adventure. We are a safe space for all and also have many fun things to distract you from your original mission. Come sleep on our trampoline, hang out the fire, participate in our tether ball tournament, get your BRC passport stamp, pick something out

HOVerlandia.name: HOVerlandia
HOVerlandia.description: Hometown: Black Rock City Designated camping for riders of the Burner Express. All riders are welcomed to camp across the street from the bus depot in HOVerlandia. Share your love for mass transit with Burners from all over the world. Contact

Hug cabana camp.name: Hug cabana camp
Hug cabana camp.description: Hometown: Nevada city, Ca Hug cabana support camp

Hungry Games.name: Hungry Games
Hungry Games.description: Hometown: San Francisco Step right up and spin our interactive game wheel for a chance to win a hot slice of fresh pizza. You might face off in a quick round of rock paper scissors or score an automatic win to satisfy your hunger. Our entire crew works together to hype up the crowd and keep the ovens firing for these spontaneous street parties. When the games take a break we invite you to sit down

Hush Hush Pony Barn.name: Hush Hush Pony Barn
Hush Hush Pony Barn.description: Hometown: Nevada City, CA Hush Hush Pony Barn is exciting to bring two offerings to playa: Our beloved Mutant Vehicle made out of reclaimed fence board and our interactivity Gossip & Guillotines. They say you’ll lose your head at Burning Man! Come see what the rumor mill and the gallery are all chatting about.

Hushville.name: Hushville
Hushville.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Albuquerque A welcoming camp with no amplified music or generators. First time burners greeted with joy and mentored with care. We welcome campers from across the world and beyond. We’ve had people from every continent camp with us in the past. Many activities all week long. Contact

Hu\u01d2 F\u00e8ng MV Support Camp.name: Huǒ Fèng MV Support Camp
Hu\u01d2 F\u00e8ng MV Support Camp.description: Hometown: Los Angeles Hu— Fèng rises as a living embodiment of the phoenix spirit. In Chinese symbolism, the phoenix represents the empress – feminine authority, grace, and sovereign power – while fire embodies transformation and rebirth. Together, Hu— Fèng becomes a vessel for renewal in motion. With sculptural wings reaching skyward and a body glowing like flame, it captures the threshold where

Hydration Station.name: Hydration Station
Hydration Station.description: Hometown: Salt Lake City, Reno, New York Come and get energized ! Jägermeister Bombs (And tequila and vodka ) daily from 2-4pm Sunday – Friday!! Water and Gatorade and shade available during the heat of the day!! Contact

HYPERSPACE.name: HYPERSPACE
HYPERSPACE.description: Hometown: Denver We are a small LGBTQ camp that loves volunteering our time with different Burning Man departments. We were previously known for UFO lounger pods and blacklight minigolf.

I Love Elephants.name: I Love Elephants
I Love Elephants.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Bend I Love Elephants Camp is a gathering space celebrating art, animals, and connection. Our open Living Commons invites participants to explore interactive installations devoted to the creatures people love, from elephants to wolves, bees, ravens, and more. At the heart of the camp is the Gaia Dome, inspired by the spirit of Ram Dass, featuring visionary art, conversations, tea gath

I Taste Purple.name: I Taste Purple
I Taste Purple.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Reno Step into a world where a psychedelic dream meets a desert carnival. Look for our kaleidoscope of purples and our signature lips and tongue logo?we’re a vibrant, welcoming oasis on the playa. At our camp, creativity knows no bounds. Join us for crafting, contests, parties, our one-of-a-kind “triathlon,” advice of all kinds, and other surprises we dream up each year. Whether you s

Icarus Camp.name: Icarus Camp
Icarus Camp.description: Hometown: NYC Icarus Camp A collection of humans from across the globe, who were brought together show all, LOVE.

ICU: Impromptu Crafters Union.name: ICU:  Impromptu Crafters Union
ICU: Impromptu Crafters Union.description: Hometown: Atlanta Suffering from crafter withdrawal? Visit the ICU for a daily dose of creativity in the shade, cuz making Art cures what ails ya! Craft offerings change daily. Contact

IcyHands Chillzone.name: IcyHands Chillzone
IcyHands Chillzone.description: Hometown: Los Angeles We seek out the weary, the overheated and the disconnected to offer our signature Icy Hands experience. The instantaneous sense of relief, joy and connection turns recipients into PARTICIPANTS and makes them part of a larger whole. Icy Hands epitomizes “the gift that keeps on giving” by coaching recipients through providing the experience to others. Hands are cooled to near f

IGNITED STATES.name: IGNITED STATES
IGNITED STATES.description: Hometown: Phoenix Ignited States is all about our states of mind, our states of being, our states of consciousness. It’s about lighting up our worlds. It’s about igniting and fanning the flames of our creativity. And sometimes, it’s about igniting the fire in our bellies with a shot of fireball. – Ignite your artful state by making a flag to illustrate the state you’re in – Ignite your wakeful sta

IHOTT: After Dark.name: IHOTT: After Dark
IHOTT: After Dark.description: Hometown: Seattle IHOTT (Intergalactic House of Time Travelers) is back with a twist! This year we welcome IHOTT: After Dark, an elevated, bespoke cocktail and ramen based night time version of your old favorite time travelling camp! Grab a cocktail in our glassware from our bartender, or sit down for the best meal you’ll have all week!

Illumination Village.name: Illumination Village
Illumination Village.description: Hometown: San Francisco Illumination Village is an eclectic gathering of camps, held together by history and shared resources. You will find within the village, much like the microcosm of Burning Man, art and interactivity everywhere. Step into a glowing neighborhood where fire, light, music, and human connection collide. By day, find coffee, tea, a public steam bath, workshops, and welcoming spac

Illuminaughty.name: Illuminaughty
Illuminaughty.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Los Angeles Look up and follow the LED Ball to Camp Illuminaughty where naughty meets light. Join us on Tuesday and Thursday from 9pm until 2am! DJs will help save your life in front of our brilliant 18′ Penrose Tile Wall. Drop by any other time for pictures with the art, perfect shade and drinks from the always going bar! Contact

ImagiMorphia.name: ImagiMorphia
ImagiMorphia.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: LA Welcome to Camp Imorgimorphia, a space where creativity and transformation converge. Inspired by the concept of “morphing,” we invite you to explore and express your evolving self through art, interactive experiences, and collaboration. Join us for immersive installations, transformative rituals, and workshops focused on personal growth and creative expression. Whether you’re seeki

Imagine Nation Art Lounge.name: Imagine Nation Art Lounge
Imagine Nation Art Lounge.description: Hometown: Kramatorsk, Ukraine Remember how you felt when you were drawing on kitchen tables and living room floors? Tap back into a state of mind that embodied the purist creative version of yourself! We encourage our guests to tap into their childhood imagination again through the medium of art, especially drawing and colouring.

Impromptu Tomato.name: Impromptu Tomato
Impromptu Tomato.description: Hometown: Seattle Your neighborhood coffeeshop serving The Playa’s Most Adequate Coffee every morning. Bring your cup. Milks, sugars, light snacks, shade, and good conversation provided. Find us by the giant tomato – our gently cooled and ventilated chill space.

IN DUST WE TRUST.name: IN DUST WE TRUST
IN DUST WE TRUST.description: Hometown: Santa Rosa A lovely camp, which has been giving away lingerie and pasties in exchange for a good life story for over 10 years now, serving snow cones in the afternoon sun and filled with people from all over the world, whose paths to our camp are always somehow unique and worth a story. Contact

Inappropirates.name: Inappropirates
Inappropirates.description: Hometown: Oakland Come for piping hot pour over coffee! Meet interesting people! Challenge the Strip Plank! A harrowing game of skill and poise, walk the plank, grab the cock all while the crowd heckles you with supportive guff (and sass!). Each time you fail, you can try again, but the price is an article of clothing! Winners get to skip the coffee line, losers lose more than their shirt… 9am to

Indigo\u2019s Speakeasy.name: Indigo’s Speakeasy
Indigo\u2019s Speakeasy.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: SF Bay Area Serving the finest of fermented bog water since 2010. Come sit and enjoy a dram. Tell us about your latest encounter. We love to listen to a good story.

InfiniTea.name: InfiniTea
InfiniTea.description: Hometown: Denver If fate finds you at our sparkling Tea Spot floating upon the vast desert ocean, come and take a sip of InfiniTea! Contact

Inflatable Wildlife.name: Inflatable Wildlife
Inflatable Wildlife.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Brooklyn, NY Inflatable Wildlife is the premiere destination for all indigenous inflatables of the playa. With a menagerie of inflatable wildlife, steady stream of danceable beats and wild and wondrous interaction helping to magnify the natural syncopated basslines which undulate through us all, we will be serving Daily Spirits Tastings, Inflatable Goat Yoga, Playa Jewelry Making, our

ING.name: ING
ING.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: South Lake Tahoe ING is a participatory camp with daily gatherings, a tea tent, interactive art, a tower for sunrise and sunset hangs, and our long-running Thursday My Tie, Mai Tai, Funk and Bass party. We serve cocktails for those 21+, zero proof drinks, and a steady mix of conversation, shade, and shenanigans all week. By night, our tower beacon helps guide dusty wanderers home. No

Insomnophilia.name: Insomnophilia
Insomnophilia.description: Hometown: Seattle Insomnophilia is erecting the House of Pachi for Axis Mundi. Welcoming back the river otter who walks between worlds — water and land, waking and dream, earthly and celestial. for Axis Mundi. Witness the sacred arc of birth, ministry, daily communion, death, and resurrection across the week. Whether you arrive by chance or by calling, you are expected. Come worship, confess, pray

Interaction Caf\u00e9.name: Interaction Café
Interaction Caf\u00e9.description: We create a space where servers get to create their ideal burning man experience by choosing interactions offered to guests who come by, and guests choose whichever of their offerings tickles their fancy. The result is consensual weird and wonderful experiences, and it’s hard to leave our camp, because you never know what might happen next: one moment it’s sweet and moving, and the next it’s rowdy

Interzone.name: Interzone
Interzone.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Indianapolis Transport yourself to another time and place as you enter Tangier’s International Zone. Grab a book from our Lost Times Library and hang out in our lounge area, open 24/7. Library Loud Hours daily from 3pm-6pm with iced Moroccan mint tea and craft beer on tap!

Iron Monkeys.name: Iron Monkeys
Iron Monkeys.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Seattle Home to the Iron Monkeys Contact

Irrelephant Bird Camp.name: Irrelephant Bird Camp
Irrelephant Bird Camp.description: Hometown: Pacifica Colorful eyebrows? CHECK! Dunking Contest? CHECK! Bad Movies? CHECK! Yacht rock? Jock rock? Not rock? Check, check, and check! Trying to get a handle on what we do here at Irrelephant Bird Camp? Don’t even try it. Just come by and get a little silly with us, touch base with reality, or take a nap on the beach. Contact

It\u2019s Only Natural.name: It’s Only Natural
It\u2019s Only Natural.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Reno Our camp offers a safe and inclusive environment for individuals wishing to participate in naturism. The space is fully enclosed, shielding participants from cell phones, cameras, and onlookers in the city. Inside, you will find a communal gathering area, with games, music, and a daily cocktail hour. We provide a friendly, non-sexualized setting for anyone wishing to experience n

Jail of Hedone.name: Jail of Hedone
Jail of Hedone.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Carlos A lush red lounge and stage devoted to Hedone, the Goddess of Sensual Pleasure. Guests are “charged” with ridiculous crimes, tried in a theatrical court, and sentenced to spin our giant Wheel of Fate for playful, consensual “punishments”. Expect the finest DJs, engaging theatrical performances, a misted dance floor, along with a stripper pole, a comfy sea of couches and pil

Janky Barge.name: Janky Barge
Janky Barge.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco Janky Barge is an art car and all the people who made it. We cruise around the desert and have fun and play music we like. You should get on! We’ll give you a ride to wherever we were already going.

Jelly Dance.name: Jelly Dance
Jelly Dance.description: Hometown: Monterey DANCE in our lighted “Psychedelic JELLY-fish Forest” which responds to your touch and enjoy live music from the house band or DJ sets late afternoon/evenings. Join us for band “jam-a-longs”, midnight acoustic “Jelly Jams” in the Jelly Forest , “Dust Street Hockey”, or very small cocktails at our “Mini-Bar”.

Jitters & Bitters.name: Jitters & Bitters
Jitters & Bitters.description: We will be serving cold brew with milk and dairy alternatives and ice! Hangout space in the shade with chairs provided to get out of the sun and get jittery. Service is in the morning and we will have 1 midnight brew session to help stay up until the sunrise!

Johnny Tacomas at The Last Resort.name: Johnny Tacomas at The Last Resort
Johnny Tacomas at The Last Resort.description: Hometown: Tacoma Here at The Last Resort motel we pride ourselves on our 5 star attitude and 1 star accommodations. Busted shoe? Empty stomach? Flat tires? Tired hoofs? Take a load off! We might possibly have what you need. Please take a number, have a seat, and someone will be with you shortly. You can grab a bite at our playa renowned flagship diner, Johnny Tacomas. The menu changes hourly to of

Joie de Vivre.name: Joie de Vivre
Joie de Vivre.description: Hometown: New York/Los Angeles At Joie de Vivre, we’re all about bringing the joy — even when the dust is thick and the tacos are hotter than the weather. Swing by in the morning for a rotating mix of movement, writing, or a card reading. Stick around for Taco Tuesday (yes, it’s real), and spin the Wheel of Feels — our 24/7 interactive art piece — for a little unexpected magic.

Joyism.name: Joyism
Joyism.description: Hometown: San Francisco Bay area n/A Contact

Joyism MVSC.name: Joyism MVSC
Joyism MVSC.description: Hometown: Santa Cruz, CA The home of the Joyism artcar, the temple for the Joyism religion, the religion of the 30th century! Contact

Juicy Rootz.name: Juicy Rootz
Juicy Rootz.description: Hometown: Brooklyn Welcome to Juicy Rootz, where the fruit is juicy, the vibes are juicier. Swing by and meet us, the delightfully playful, slightly unhinged, and always heart-centered Juicies! We’re serving up two workshops/parties where you can get your hands sticky making wearable art out of dried, resin-soaked citrus. That’s right—your new accessory is made of fruit. Come for the fruit, stay f

Jungle Oddity.name: Jungle Oddity
Jungle Oddity.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Nevada City A jungle oasis lost in time and space. Stop by to experience our lush soundscapes with musical performances and engaging daily workshops. Contact

Just Dandy.name: Just Dandy
Just Dandy.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Reno Support camp for Dandy mutant vehicle.

KAIF.name: KAIF
KAIF.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Odessa Step into the cool ambiance of our cozy KAIF Lounge, a haven where relaxation, creativity, and connection come to life. Unwind with a refreshing expertly crafted cocktails. Immerse yourself in spiritual practices, or sip and dance your way into bliss. Whether you seek movement, mindfulness, or just a moment to savor, KAIF Lounge is your escape on the Playa. Contact

Kaleidoscope.name: Kaleidoscope
Kaleidoscope.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco Step into a world of color and indulge your caffeine addictions at Kaleidoscope, where we bring people together over exquisite single origin coffee sourced and roasted by our campmates, prepared and brewed in front of you at our bar, one cup at a time. Our vibrant, welcoming space adorned with low tables, cushions, and ambient music, invites you to slow down, savor the m

Kamp Kaos.name: Kamp Kaos
Kamp Kaos.description: Hometown: Boston Celebrating all that is chaotic! KAOS campers hail from across the US. We celebrate curious minds, artists, engineers, makers, and anyone with an open mind. We bring something new every year!

Kamp Kit.name: Kamp Kit
Kamp Kit.description: Hometown: Fernley We specialize only in infused liquor shots, infusing all the flavors ourselves. Some are delicious. Some are too hot to handle. Some are pretty gross. No mixers, no chasers! If you’re not drinking, or done drinking, you can contribute to the Playa Name Archive or participate in our open mic.

Karma Love Camp.name: Karma Love Camp
Karma Love Camp.description: Hometown: Albuquerque A welcoming oasis designed for connection, relaxation, and playful interaction. We offer body art, unique experiences, dance, gifting, and a friendly space to simply be. Our camp is a chill rest stop where you can relax, recharge, and connect with new friends. Whether you’re looking to join a fun event or just hang out and chat, Karma Love Camp is here to share joy and genuin

KashyyyK.name: KashyyyK
KashyyyK.description: Hometown: New York Your favorite wookiees are back! Swing by the legendary Wookiee Bodega, open daily from 12?5PM. Modeled after a classic NYC corner store, it’s stocked with playa essentials (sunscreen, tampons, reusable water bottles) and completely unnecessary treasures (bedazzled jewelry, candy bars, knick-knacks galore). This year we’ve expanded the magic with Wardrobi, our free-playa costume

Kaya.name: Kaya
Kaya.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Detroit Home of the Fire Breathing Dragon Art Car, Gon KiRin. Stop by our camp to enjoy music, meet our camp members from around the globe and experience an authentic tea ceremony by tea masters from China. We are a diverse group of burners brought together by our love for art, music and cultural exchange. Feel free to ask questions about our mutant vehicle and maybe catch a ride with

Kentucky Fried Camp.name: Kentucky Fried Camp
Kentucky Fried Camp.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Lexington Kentucky Fried Campers only need one spice, and that’s the spice of life. If you wanna taste it, join us any time of day or night. We begin each morning with the best hot breakfast on playa; a shot of Kentucky bourbon served with a fried baloney sandwich. Afternoons you’ll find us relaxing in our Olde Kentucky Dome, crafting, napping, match-making, and lots of watching the B

Khaleeya.name: Khaleeya
Khaleeya.description: Hometown: All over Come immerse yourself in a world of Moroccan bliss at Khaleeya —where the hive thrives in harmony. Contact

Kidsville.name: Kidsville
Kidsville.description: Hometown: Kidsville honestly does not have a home town. We started on playa with families from all over. We are truly from everywhere, however if we have to pick a hometown: Our Mayor is from Austin, TX. Kidsville is a playful family village where young Burners and their grownups can find adventure, community, and a touch of magic on playa. With trampolines, playgrounds, kid friendly treats, daily

Kinky Pizza.name: Kinky Pizza
Kinky Pizza.description: Hometown: San Mateo Hot slices, Hot flogging, and Hot fire. It’s only kinky the first time… Contact

Kinsey Walhberg Field Lab.name: Kinsey Walhberg Field Lab
Kinsey Walhberg Field Lab.description: Hometown: Penngrove Welcome to the Kinsey Walhberg Field Lab. This groundbreaking camp, developed by the esteemed Lindsey Kinsey and Remy Walhberg, stands at the vanguard of art analysis, offering training for those interested in their unique and comprehensive framework that transcends conventional critique methodologies. Enter KWASI-3. KWASI-3 is not just an assessment tool; it is a revolution in

Knot Sure.name: Knot Sure
Knot Sure.description: Hometown: Watsonville Come to Knot Sure and play our spinning wheel game hang out or get a decorative rope top. Contact

Knotty Peckers.name: Knotty Peckers
Knotty Peckers.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Luis Obispo Come get knotty at our woodland scout-themed camp blending playful nostalgia with sexy human connection and participation. Enjoy the welcoming forest outpost where Burners can gather, learn, laugh, and earn bespoke scout-style badges by participating in camp activities like: S’mores, Axe-Throwing, Paddle Play, Dirty Girl Scout drinks, and more.

Kombuchachacha.name: Kombuchachacha
Kombuchachacha.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Menlo Park Kombucha: (n) kom-BOO-cha. Renowned playa aphrodisiac. You may not get the booch you want but you will definitely get the booch you need. Cha Cha: (n) Intricate Latin American dance. The home of con+sent. Come meet our chicken(s). Relax, refresh and cha cha the day away. 4 stars on yelp 2025.

KonaZona Coffee & Tiki Bar.name: KonaZona Coffee & Tiki Bar
KonaZona Coffee & Tiki Bar.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Kona KonaZona Tiki Bar, Serving Liquid Hugs for your brain in a Tropical setting. Coffee in the morning, Mai Tai’s in the Afternoon. Chill in our Tropical Hammocks and relax with the soothing Hawaii sounds and cooling surroundings Contact

Kosmik Dust.name: Kosmik Dust
Kosmik Dust.description: Hometown: Las Vegas Please stop by and play Fire Skee Ball! with your friends and campmates! Check out our other technological interactivities such as our High Striker and Theramyd. Take a spin on our Tipsey Totter and Merry-Go-Round! Contact

Kuker Camp.name: Kuker Camp
Kuker Camp.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Westminster BULGARIAN KUKER Mutant Vehicle is based on the Kukeri Ritual Dancers – a millenia old tradition from Bulgaria, Eastern Europe. Kukeri are people wearing elaborate self-made fur costumes and hideous animalistic masks. Every year in the end of winter/the beginning of spring Kukeri dance to scare away evil spirits and bring joy, happiness and prosperity for the whole village

Kumaya.name: Kumaya
Kumaya.description: Hometown: New York Cozy up in our 24/7 library lounge filled with pillows, blankets, books and art. Write, doodle, or read the journals lying all around, filled with the stories of visitors from past burns. Eat a pancake at our morning disco party. Pilgrimage with us to deep playa at sunrise for tea and tunes. Get some deep rest in our meditative sound bath or simply lounge and connect with fellow

Kurenivka.name: Kurenivka
Kurenivka.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Kyiv-LA Kurenivka is a Ukrainian camp built around art, hospitality, and a touch of beautiful absurdity. Home to the vibrant Blue Bull art car, we bring together Ukrainian cultural energy, welcoming vibes, tea, music, and interactive moments for passersby and participants alike. We aim to create a camp that feels alive, open, and memorable — a place where people can pause, connect, an

Kwalq Camp.name: Kwalq Camp
Kwalq Camp.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Seattle The Kwalq Camp mission is to help young polywogs achieve the best version of themselves by learning how to breath. Ready for the next level? Please stop by and we’ll help you achieve your best froggie self. Contact

La Calaca Village.name: La Calaca Village
La Calaca Village.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Empire, NV La Calaca Village offers a theme camp, art car and artist support on playa. We pride ourselves on being makers, teachers and healers . Come for the healing, stay for the hedonism! Spiritual healers, yogis and massage artists await you in our Healing Plaza. Wanna help build and work on a big art car? Visit the “Imagination Station Piazza” featuring different activities and g

LAF Lazy-Ass Fuckers.name: LAF Lazy-Ass Fuckers
LAF Lazy-Ass Fuckers.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: New Orleans Come walk through the history of Playa SWAG at The Playa Artifact Museum! We provide a look into past pins, posters, tickets and more, highlighting decades of creativity at the Burn. We host workshops with new artists and friends from years past. All are welcome!

Lakes on the Playa Village.name: Lakes on the Playa Village
Lakes on the Playa Village.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Ann Arbor The only lake on the playa, come swim Contact

Lamplighters.name: Lamplighters
Lamplighters.description: Hometown: Black Rock City Lamplighters! Longest running performance art on Playa. Come help us help YOU! Lamplighters light the city every night of the event so YOU can get home safely. We throw a volunteer party everyday at 5pm, and light the city after that. Contact

Lands Beyond.name: Lands Beyond
Lands Beyond.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Mexico City Lands Beyond is a haven for strivers and adventurers always seeking the unknown. We invite you to step beyond your comfort zone and explore new experiences with us. A globally minded camp with Mexican flair, we welcome Burners into our cosmic neon-lit domes for tasty micheladas, delicious mezcalitas and refreshing aguas frescas. Our programming includes ecstatic dance, bre

Last Camp Sitting.name: Last Camp Sitting
Last Camp Sitting.description: Hometown: San Francisco Is it a porto, is a portal? Only those who look closely will know! Contact

Latica.name: Latica
Latica.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Miami We are a very diverse camp that will exemplify radical inclusion. This camp will be mostly populated by latinX individuals from Venezuela, Mexico and various hispanic upbringings along with some strong allies. Contact

LEGENDARY Playground of the Gods.name: LEGENDARY Playground of the Gods
LEGENDARY Playground of the Gods.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Salt Lake City The Legendary Playground of the Gods is a place for learning, authentic connection, and celebrating life. This is a place to remember that we are all Divine, Infinite & Immortal beings simply wearing the disguise of being human. Come and find an oasis from the desert, find rest in the shade, get frozen treats and feast on a week of inspired offerings in workshops, class

Legends of the Hidden Playa.name: Legends of the Hidden Playa
Legends of the Hidden Playa.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Austin, TX We run an obstacle course/escape room that is loosely based off an old 90’s game show and its recent reboot. With 13 separate rooms, each with their own puzzle, we will truly test your Burning Man preparedness! We have daily timed trials to earn a spot on our leader board and see if you can solve the Shrine of the Silver Monkey-Man! Contact

Leopard Martini Lounge.name: Leopard Martini Lounge
Leopard Martini Lounge.description: Hometown: Palo Alto The LEOPARD MARTINI LOUNGE has been returning since 1998 serving top shelf cocktails in a chill area with wonderful people. CLEO the mutant vehicle with continue to roam the playa.

Lightning Bug Lounge.description: Hometown: Reno A family-friendly camp supporting Spark the Firefly as she flickers across the playa, glowing with the warmth and nostalgia of evenings spent chasing lightning bugs.

Lily Pad Lounge.name: Lily Pad Lounge
Lily Pad Lounge.description: Hometown: Emeryville, USA Home of LilyPod support camp. Have support for other small art cars, particularly those based off golfcarts. Also salve and frog-related things.

Liquid Spankuary.name: Liquid Spankuary
Liquid Spankuary.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Los Angeles Dusty, parched, and feeling a little too well-behaved? Come get refreshed and red-cheeked at Liquid Spankuary! We’re serving up ice-cold, Agua Fresca to cool your core and handmade butt spanks to fire up your afternoon. Choose your flavor and your intensity (from a “love tap” to “full playa-dust cloud”). Our certified Spank-baristas ensure every impact is consensual, respe

Lit AF.name: Lit AF
Lit AF.description: Hometown: Las Vegas Stumbling around the playa in the dark like a total darkwad? Come get Lit AF! We’ll help you add fairy lights to your bike, backpack, or outfit. Stop by for a workshop, spare batteries (AA or CR2032), or to donate extra lights or batteries to the cause. And if you need lights while you’re out and about, our Darkwad Patrol may just find you and save your poor darkwad soul. Conta

Lituanica Birds.name: Lituanica Birds
Lituanica Birds.description: Hometown: Vilnius We are Lituanica Birds Camp, a community that travels across the ocean to Black Rock City, bringing with us a cascade of ideas, energy, and love. Our camp offers welcoming spaces where ever

Live Laugh Love Lounge.description: Hometown: Bombay Beach, CA Step into the most relatable sanctuary in Black Rock City. We are a high-irony, low-stress retreat celebrating the simple comforts of suburban life with a massive gallery of reclaimed domestic art. Visitors can enjoy a nostalgic backyard experience featuring classic lawn games like cornhole and ladder toss. Come for the snacks, stay for the board games, and find your inn

LIZARD.name: LIZARD
LIZARD.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Wu Han Shang Hai Our camp welcomes you to enjoy Oriental food at any time, and we also provide iced water and drinks. Contact

Loadie Camp.description: Hometown: Arlington The home of the iconic Shark Car. Loadie Camp is a hive of Mutant Vehicle visionaries and builders, contributing over 10 different Mutant Vehicles of varying sizes. Come meet the builders and learn more about the Mutant Vehicle process.

Lollypopolus.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Portland Lollypopoluis is a theme camp based in Portland Oregon with campers from Portland, Boise, Montreal, CA and Tokyo Japan. We are focused on Self Care and provide the Self Care Pharmacy for those items you may have forgotten or didn’t know you’d need. Join us in the Circus tent for music, food, beverages and connection! Contact

Lookout! The Camp.name: Lookout! The Camp
Lookout! The Camp.description: Hometown: Portland Absurdity disguised as a fire extinguisher. The art support camp for “Lookout!”

Lost + Found.name: Lost + Found
Lost + Found.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Los Angeles We are a diverse community, a California-based collective of dreamers, artists, adventurers, and creative doers, that loves throwing fun off-the-wall parties as much as we love connecting on deeper levels. Lost and Sound.name: Lost and Sound

Lost Art.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Portland, OR Come and visit the Lost Art of Conversation Cafe! We at Lost Art celebrate opportunities to create deep connections with friends old and new. Lotus Dome & Caf\u00e9.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Seattle The Lotus Dome & Cafe offers spaces for folks to recharge, reconnect, and recenter their bodies and minds. Our camp has two main spaces. Draw a Blessing Card, leave a Love Note, and stay a little longer than you planned. Come for the aroma and curiosity, stay for the conversation and human connection.

Lunar Disco.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Santa Rosa, CA Embrace the cosmic elements in our electrifying dance and party spaces, with interstellar beats and mesmerizing ambience. Lusty Chanterelle Kombucha Bar.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco Whisky is out- Kombucha is in. The Lusty Chanterelle Kombucha bar is a place to cool down, relax, unwind, and drop in with good conversation and a cold non-alcoholic beverage with your fellow burners. Come with an empty cup and we will fill you up and help you feel at home with the most quaffable drink on playa.

M*A*S*H 4207th.name: M*A*S*H 4207th
M*A*S*H 4207th.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Portland, Oregon Attention all personnel! Come visit the MASH 4207th – best care anywhere! Return at night for a break from the chaos of the burn with nightly showings of MASH TV episodes.

MacGyvers\u2019 Union.name: MacGyvers’ Union

machinedom \u2013 the experience.description: Hometown: RENO machinedom-the experience…. come by and see us!

Since 2019, Mad Tea(se) has hosted it’s flagship Wednesday evening Cabaret Show under its iconic, striped circus tent. Contact

Magic Lantern Society.name: Magic Lantern Society
Magic Lantern Society.description: Hometown: Pacifica, CA The Magic Lantern is a wandering inn, located at the end of all worlds. Sumptuously-appointed with antiques, curiosities, games, and mysterious old books, we are a space created for deeper human connection, and a warm and inviting sanctuary for the weary and curious traveller. Our centerpiece is our unique Trading Booth, where stories and secrets are the only accepted curren

Magic Paradise.name: Magic Paradise
Magic Paradise.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Puerto Rico Dive into an oasis of wonder, where community and enchantment come together! Enjoy captivating up close magic shows, intimate speakeasy encounters, and daily afternoon treats. Let our skilled team repair your gear, and make your bike stand out with our dazzling decorations. Contact

Maison Phi.description: Hometown: New York City Maison Phi is your beautifully chaotic oasis in the dust where hydration, pancakes, yoga, and late-night dance floors all coexist in perfect imbalance. Mansonian Institute 4 Urban Study.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco Visit us to learn Burningman History from its very beginning to now from experts. Herbal tea is served as part of the ritual experience. In the afternoon, gather at our Draniki Station to enj

Martha Love.name: Martha Love
Martha Love.description: ⛺︎ Come play out fabulous games Performance Stage BRC Community space – Stage available for your use – Come and have your presentation in our space. contact us to make a reservation Martha – Historical Vehicle – Longest continuous art car on the playa . Sharing Love; Jump on board and enjoy the loving company, visit the artists, and the best beats in Black Rock

Matcha Mama.name: Matcha Mama
Matcha Mama.description: Hometown: Manhattan A daytime oasis serving handcrafted matcha lattes and meaningful connection. Stop by for a refreshing drink made to order, then settle into our shaded “Spill the Tea” lounge for conversation, reflection, or simply a moment of rest. Math Camp @ Group W.name: Math Camp @ Group W
Math Camp @ Group W.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: East Palo Alto A Safe place to drink and Derive. Share your problems with us. Contact

MAXA.name: MAXA
MAXA.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Mexico City We are Maxa, rooted in family. built by hand We create warmth, bringing people together through art and music. Contact

Maybe You Should Talk To Someone.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Joshua Tree Our camp provides on-playa counseling services, offering burners a space to process emotions, navigate conflicts, and reconnect with their experience in a meaningful way. By blending therapeutic support with

Mellow Mountain.description: Hometown: San Francisco Bay, mostly Mellow Mountain invites you to trade smooches with the Kissy Fish art car, play on our swings and rings, and be served kid-made lemonade and espresso martinis. Contact
