MIDAS TEAR COLLECTIVE.name: MIDAS TEAR COLLECTIVE
MIDAS TEAR COLLECTIVE.description: Hometown: BELLOC City Step into a welcoming French gathering space where conversations flow alongside French wine and cheese. Join us in building a collaborative geometric sculpture using Zometool, an evolving creation shaped collectively throughout the week. At sunrise, gather beneath The Tear of Midas for meditation, reflection, and community sharing circles. Relax, create, exchange ideas, and i

Midnight Roast.name: Midnight Roast
Midnight Roast.description: Hometown: Dallas Late Night Afterhours Coffee + Music! The ONLY coffee service after midnight. Contact

Mighty Misfits.name: Mighty Misfits
Mighty Misfits.description: Hometown: Denver A Mighty Misfit is a person whose behavior or attitude sets them apart from others in a conspicuous way, yet somehow makes it okay. A fish out of water, square peg in a round hole, round peg in a square hole. If you’ve ever felt you don’t fit in in the default world, come and play with the Mighty Misfits. We are a welcoming, dusty respite with a misfit list of activities. Feed you

Miki Beach.name: Miki Beach
Miki Beach.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Miami Miki Beach is inspired from an array of beach lounges in Miami and the Caribbean, and mimicking these beach lounge vibes, we are striving to create an open, breezy, colorful environment to relax and have fun. Miki Beach is your desert oasis so come celebrate with us at one of our playful parties, sip on one of our delectable libations, visit us for our Brazilian BBQ on Saturday

Mimosa.name: Mimosa
Mimosa.description: Hey you, yes you our dear friend! I know what you want, or I would say even need. A fresh, cold MIMOSA. Please step by our bar where we will get you what you need.

Mindseye Bonsai.name: Mindseye Bonsai
Mindseye Bonsai.description: ⛺︎ We are a small art support camp of builders, artists, scientists, and dusty travelers from all over the world. Our mission is to bring sculpture to the playa and have a good time doing it. With 10 years of experience bringing art to Burning Man, we love sharing neuroscience-inspired art and curiosity with fellow dusty desert folks. If that sounds like your kind of camp, reach out and come join

MindShark.name: MindShark
MindShark.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Burlington Stay out of Mindshark, we’re glad to have you! We serve questionable drinks with confidence, blast music you didn’t ask for, and light up the night with fire and LED absurdity. While you are staying out of MindShark you may participate and spectate as brave souls attempt our infamous bar games, flow with our LED dome, or trigger columns of flames to the beat of the music. E

Mindwerk.name: Mindwerk
Mindwerk.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Redwood City Come to Mindwerk and ride our slide!! Relax in our shady dome and enjoy a Pomerosegasm, the most delicious and refreshing cocktail in Black Rock City! Climb up to our viewing platform where you can behold a 360 degree view of our beautiful metropolis. Exhilarating egress is provided by a convenient slide. It’s been called “just the right amount of sketchy” by satisfied cu

Misfits Menagerie.name: Misfits Menagerie
Misfits Menagerie.description: Hometown: Vegas Glowy tent with helix tower, worst bartender, weirdest games, and belly laughs

Mission Country Club.name: Mission Country Club
Mission Country Club.description: Hometown: San Francisco Hailing from the sunny Mission District of San Francisco, we invite everyone to enjoy the dusty comforts of our playa outpost. Pull up a bar stool at Flanagan’s Pub – open day and night – for a refreshing beverage. Cozy up on one of our couches beneath the ample and breezy shade structure. Let loose on the dance floor. We’re a relaxed and fun-loving crowd from all over – Sa

Mist Connections.name: Mist Connections
Mist Connections.description: Hometown: San Francisco Misconnections is a tiny temple to bad timing, chaotic crushes, and emotional side quests. Stumble in, get aggressively misted, and accept an irresponsible amount of shave ice while you write anonymous notes to the hottie from the porta line, the stranger who rescued your bike, or the person you trauma?bonded with at sunrise.

Misters & Sisters.name: Misters & Sisters
Misters & Sisters.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Sacramento We are a fun daytime camp, offering two main activities, 1) overhead water misters, accessible all week from dawn to dusk, operated by staff or self-service, and, 2) a DIY Essential Oil body spray activity from noon to 3 p.m. Monday, Tuesday and Wednesday (with Friday as backup for bad weather). We have 26 different essential oils to choose from and will show you how to mix

Mo\u2019s Mini Martini + Erotica Camp.name: Mo’s Mini Martini + Erotica Camp
Mo\u2019s Mini Martini + Erotica Camp.description: Hometown: Mill Valley Mohammeds serves the coldest martinis and the hottest erotica on the playa. Come and join us for an ice cold martini in a REAL martini glass and, if the spirit moves you, write down your own true erotic tale in our 400 year old book filled with the daring do’s of other Black Rock Citizens. We open after lunch at 1:00pm and close when the camels go to bed, around 1:00am.

Mobility Camp.name: Mobility Camp
Mobility Camp.description: Hometown: Tucson, AZ We offer Oh Shiny! Tours for anyone who wants to get out and explore the incredible art. We give priority to people with physical disabilities. We also provide crutches and wheelchairs for anyone who gets injured on the playa. Public charging station for Medical Equipment. Stop by and check out our obstacle course! Contact

Molotov Cocktail.name: Molotov Cocktail
Molotov Cocktail.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Tacoma Our shaded bar/chill space offers welcome respite and comfort for the dusty and thirsty. We will be bringing a variety of home brewed and concocted alcoholic beverages for the citizens of Black Rock City. We offer a variety of games including cribbage and ten thousand/farkle.

Mona Camp.name: Mona Camp
Mona Camp.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Berkeley Welcome to Mona Camp, where the spirit of caring, loving, and creativity thrives amidst the vast expanse of the playa. As part of the same community that brought you the Huge Mona Bunny in 2023, the enchanting Mona Mushroom in 2024, and the MONA DIE! DIE! DIE! burn in 2025. We are dedicated to spreading the Mona spirit far and wide. We believe in the power of art to inspire,

Monkey King Camp.name: Monkey King Camp
Monkey King Camp.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Los Angeles A playful cultural playground on the Playa filled with DJ sets, music, interactive art, games, drinks, Asian inspired food gifting, and Monkey King energy. Come explore our Dragon Pillars, catch live sets from DJs and artists on our stage, hang out in our lounge spaces, share tea, snacks, and good vibes, and jump into spontaneous moments of fun with fellow Burners. By day

Moon Cheese.name: Moon Cheese
Moon Cheese.description: Hometown: San Francisco We still believe the moon is made out of cheese. That’s why we serve grilled cheese sandwiches throughout the week to the hungry citizens of Black Rock City. Stocked with all different types of bread & cheese and a range of sweet, spicy, tangy & juicy dipping sauces, we’re grilling under the stars to satisfy the cravings of all those dancing & adventuring at night. Contact

Moon Landing.name: Moon Landing
Moon Landing.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Oakland Moon Landing, a celestial outpost of creativity, exploration, and radical self-expression at Burning Man. Our camp is a launchpad for dreamers, builders, and cosmic wanderers?a space where art, technology, and human connection intersect in gravity-defying ways. Inspired by the pioneering spirit of lunar exploration, we craft immersive experiences that transport participants be

Moonlight Collective.name: Moonlight Collective
Moonlight Collective.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Oakland The Moonlight Collective is part of the Temple Crew hub and will be supporting the Temple of the Moon build. Come visit our bar and have a chat with the Entity. Meet the team that designed the temple this year and share your stories. Contact

Moonraker.name: Moonraker
Moonraker.description: Hometown: Las Vegas Moonraker Mutant vehicle, 10th year. Contact

MOOP MAP HQ.name: MOOP MAP HQ
MOOP MAP HQ.description: Hometown: San Francisco MOOP Map HQ is Playa Restoration’s home base ? part LNT response center, part history hub, part hangout. We’re like a firehouse for MOOP, ready to roll out when there’s an issue. It’s also where you’ll find past MOOP Maps, interactive displays, and friendly faces happy to chat about Leave No Trace or how to join the Resto crew! Contact

More Is More.name: More Is More
More Is More.description: Hometown: Los Angeles Reality is a suggestion. Excess is a plan. Climb our wood tower, enjoy drinks and DJ with us daily.

Mos Eisley Village.name: Mos Eisley Village
Mos Eisley Village.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Western USA Mos Eisley… You will never find a more wretched hive of scum and villainy. We must be cautious.

Mostly in Tune.name: Mostly in Tune
Mostly in Tune.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Santa Cruz, CA Leave with dusty shoes and a song stuck in your head. Mostly in Tune is a participatory jam camp. Join the band, borrow an instrument, sing along, enjoy live band karaoke, perform spoken word over live backing tracks, or simply enjoy the music. No experience required. Want to join a camp and actually make music? We’re looking for a drummer and keyboard player to complet

Mountain Mayhem.name: Mountain Mayhem
Mountain Mayhem.description: Hometown: Durango Straight from the Colorado Rockies, Mountain Mayhem is the greatest dive bar on the playa. With the best drinks, games, and bartenders to be found, we will be sure to keep it hot while staying cool. Come by for a thirst quenching snowjob and a shotski, or have your socks blown off at connect 4. Contact

Mouse House.name: Mouse House
Mouse House.description: Hometown: Seattle You know who loves hammocks? Mice love hammocks. If you also love hammocks, you might be a mouse yourself! Come to the Mouse House to get in touch with your inner rodent. Vibes so chill you might find yourself trapped.

Mouse Trap.name: Mouse Trap
Mouse Trap.description: Hometown: Reno Keep your friends close, but your cheese closer!

Mudskippers.name: Mudskippers
Mudskippers.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Los Angeles The Home of Pop in the Playa, we are a radically-inclusive, diverse and expressive tight-knit group of lovers from all over the globe. We’re a worldwide network of friends and a family. We work and play together to make the burn more fun and give bigger to those that come to our theme camp. Come enjoy our Pop Gym, our amazing dance parties, fun workshops, or just come chil

Mural Maze Support Camp.name: Mural Maze Support Camp
Mural Maze Support Camp.description: Hometown: Denver Mural Maze Art Support Camp is a collaborative space supporting a group of muralists creating a large scale installation on playa.

MUSE (Maenad University).name: MUSE (Maenad University)
MUSE (Maenad University).description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Jose The Maenad University for the Study of the Esoteric (M.U.S.E.) is a tribute to the deity Dionyus and offers a temple space for offerings as well as for our interactivity which ranges from spiritual to silly. We offer a 24 hour labyrinth for visitors to use as well as a kiosk which will host a variety of camp run and visitor run interactivity. We are a very welcoming group and

MUSE Caf\u00e9.name: MUSE Café
MUSE Caf\u00e9.description: Hometown: San Diego MUSE is a nod, a wink, a slap on the bum. It is a toast to the muse in you and the muse in me. It’s booty shaking praise and it’s champagne smiles. It is a place where we can embrace both the funky and meaningful. Our goal is to honor & celebrate the inspiration in every human being. We create a space and curate events that ignite the playful & seductive spirit of the muse. Our

Mutant Ninja Burners.name: Mutant Ninja Burners
Mutant Ninja Burners.description: Hometown: Phoenix Are you looking for a place to kick up your dusty boots or maybe somewhere to warm up during the cold night? At Mutant Ninja Burners when you cross our sewer rat picket fence you’re one of us! Don a headband, dance and groove to some wubs. Learn some sick nunchuck skillz. Warm yourself by the fire pits. You’ll be rewarded with friendship, acceptance and a hot slice of pizza if yo

My Favorite Things.name: My Favorite Things
My Favorite Things.description: Hometown: San Francisco, East Bay When the dust hits, we turn to our favorite things?cooling, comforting, and slightly questionable. Stop by for a reset, a little delight, and maybe something you’ll pretend you didn’t love as much as you did. Contact

Mystic.name: Mystic
Mystic.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Bay Area + Los Angeles CA + Denver, CO + New York, NY Mystic is a legendary theme camp with 20+ years of magic in Black Rock City ? a vibrant sanctuary of interactive art, transcendent music, and soul-expanding workshops. BY DAY: Dive into our Visionary Speaker Series, Healing Modalities, and Mind-Body Workshops inside the iconic Mystic Theater and Mystic Temple. BY NIGHT: Lose yourse

Mystikal Misfits.name: Mystikal Misfits
Mystikal Misfits.description: Hometown: Southern California This year the Mystical Misfits celebrate 23 years on Playa. We will be providing the beautiful Narwhal as a stationary stage for Performances, DJs, and a shaded rest spot for Burners. We plan to have Daily events on the Narwhal during the day and evening. We will also have a Bar. Seeing refreshments to Participate everyday at Happy Hour. They will also have DJs schedu

Mystopia.name: Mystopia
Mystopia.description: Hometown: San Francisco Step out of the sun-scorched wonderland into our cool haven. It’s an icy oasis, an ice cream paradise, and a sanctuary for all. We welcome everyone: friends, partners, parents, children, individuals of any race, orientation and identity. Stop by our burner family and experience the rainbow of diversity. Come play with us, sit down and watch some drag/burlesque, dance with a

NAACB.name: NAACB
NAACB.description: Hometown: NYC NAACB (National Association for the Advancement of Colored Burners)

Naked Heart.name: Naked Heart
Naked Heart.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Eugene Naked Heart is devoted to the full embodiment of the divine feminine. We offer amazing experiential and experimental workshops that allow you to feel your feminine heart, your radiance, your inner goddess. This work requires the masculine as well; Everyone is welcome. At Naked Heart we recognize the need to embrace both the light and the dark in our journeys. When we pursue the

Native Tongues.name: Native Tongues
Native Tongues.description: Hometown: Harlem USA A Native Tongue speaks to the frequency we all share, a common way of communicating with love, empathy & respect. An acknowledgment of the humanity we recognize in each other. And also a kick ass rap collective from the 90’s!

Navigate to YES.name: Navigate to YES
Navigate to YES.description: ⛺︎ Find your destiny on playa with our GPS – Global Persuasion System Contact

Neodebauchery.name: Neodebauchery
Neodebauchery.description: Hometown: Reno We are a throng of dome-dwelling miscreants, hooligans, bloviators, simps, warlocks, horse girls, diggerfish, and charlatans. As one of the aforementioned groups, your birthright compels you to complete the pilgrimage to the fabled land of Neodebauchery. A melange of tomfoolery new and old, Neodebauchery provides a welcoming space for weirdos of all creeds, colors, and degree of cru

NetsaH.name: NetsaH
NetsaH.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Tel Aviv Explorers and curious souls, every shared energy is etched into eternity.

Never Sleep Again.name: Never Sleep Again
Never Sleep Again.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: LA, SF, Berlin Inspired by the vibes of Berlin nightclubs and the global underground party scene, we bring deep, groovy beats to an intimate dance floor enclosed by lush chill spaces with beds, couches, cushions, and pillows for when you need to reset. Drift between dancing, lounging, sharing a drink, playing games, and getting lost in moments with other burners. Our space pulses with

New Desert Outpost.name: New Desert Outpost
New Desert Outpost.description: Hometown: Oakland, CA We are an eclectic, antique outpost for wanderers and those seeking adventure. Contact

Next Year on Luna.name: Next Year on Luna
Next Year on Luna.description: Hometown: Bridgeport, CA We explore the question: as the shifting systems around us shape our experiences and our lives, what does it mean to maintain our essential humanity and ultimately to remain, or become, ourselves?

Nipple Crime.name: Nipple Crime
Nipple Crime.description: Hometown: Reno Nipple crime is a Reno based theme camp dedicated to memorable experiences. Come have a drink at our extensive home-brewed bar. Friday’s Sensual Hotdog eating contest is our biggest event and won’t disappoint. We are mostly a day camp but often have small parties well into the morning. Contact

Nipple Pie.name: Nipple Pie
Nipple Pie.description: Hometown: Brooklyn, NY Welcomes you to join us for our early night parties, whether it is to stomp our dancefloor or to simply sip on a refreshing cocktail in our cozy lounge. At the start of the new night, when our projectors launch their state of the art 3D projections onto our 50ft mural, and when the beats roar up to the busy avenue, that’s when Nipple Pie shines the best Contact

No Drama Camp.name: No Drama Camp
No Drama Camp.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Santa Maria We are all inclusive Camp that provides the Citizens of Black Rock City with a fun and interesting place to stop by for a Drink at the No Drama Bar. We host many daily events under our large shade structure. Nightly DJ’s play music for those stopping by on their way around the Playa. Enjoy our fun oversized Bar Games, while you sip some of the best drinks to be found. Ther

No Holes Barred Comedy Club.name: No Holes Barred Comedy Club
No Holes Barred Comedy Club.description: Hometown: Los Angeles We know you missed us! We’re back to make you laugh! Start your day with some coldbrew and comic strips, chill out in our giggle inducing Meditation Sessions, learn how to make friends and strangers laugh, and cry, in our variety of Story Telling and Stand Up, and comedy related Workshops, then test your new skills at Open Mic. Got beef with your campmates? Join us for “Judge

NO STAIRWAY TO HEAVEN.name: NO STAIRWAY TO HEAVEN
NO STAIRWAY TO HEAVEN.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Oakland Musicians and wanderers gather here for open jam sessions where anyone can join the circle with instruments, percussion, or pure curiosity. Our signature event, Jam Battle, invites players into a friendly one-on-one improvisational showdown inspired by dance battles and musical conversation. Throughout the week visitors can relax in the lounge, share moments of spontaneous mus

Nobo House.name: Nobo House
Nobo House.description: ⛺︎ Nobo House is an international, quirky Holistic Wellness & Recovery camp that is a place of refuge for playa adventurers, artists, & builders. Our gift is a chill playa spa, that includes a steam room, outdoor gym, dance classes, massages and smoothies. Contact

Nocino\u2019s.name: Nocino’s
Nocino\u2019s.description: Hometown: San Diego That cozy social place where people come to hang after a long day of [redacted] and [censored] to connect with beer, pizza, and good music. Contact

Node.name: Node
Node.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Brooklyn Node is an oasis of epic proportions. Stop by for drinks, vibes and beats. Dont miss our Hip Hop BBQ on Wednesday!

Nom De Plume.name: Nom De Plume
Nom De Plume.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Yerba Mateville, Maine We are a tea lounge that has yerba mate brewing the entire event in our circus tent. Come by to kick it, chill, and lounge. Relax while thriving, and drinking tea. The way life should be. We have a variety of other teas available throughout the week but always have yerba mate brewing. Sit down and hydrate while you start or finish your day. Yerba Mate Dub starts

noMADart.name: noMADart
noMADart.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Forestville CA noMADart Camp one of few Deaf Family Friendly camps that offer daily renewable art project where you can make a gift, memory and connection all in one stop. We pride ourselves with openness and awareness of the Burning Man Ethos and Principles. Dusty Hugs Contact

Nordic Paradise.name: Nordic Paradise
Nordic Paradise.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Gothenburg Where cold-brew coffee meets an exciting bar and cafe. Explore workshops for body and mind, dance to music, and chill out in style. Join our Qurious Viking party, celebrating all gender expressions. It’s an unforgettable experience waiting for you. Welcome to Nordic Paradise! Contact

Norms Garage.name: Norms Garage
Norms Garage.description: Hometown: Bend, OR Norms Garage and its Handle Bar is a space full of bike-based furniture and a human-powered blender bar, recycling default world bike parts into new lives and uses on playa. We also host a variety of bike-oriented events, teaching people the delicate art of how to physically and emotionally ride a tandem, jousting on a big wheels trike, how to do the limbo on two wheels, and hos

NORSE CODE.name: NORSE CODE
NORSE CODE.description: Hometown: Venice Beach Norse Code is an international camp centered on music, dance, movement, and human connection. We create an open, welcoming space where campers and visitors can gather, participate, and engage with one another in meaningful ways. Our elevated deck serves as the heart of camp life, hosting yoga, breathwork, sound baths, exercise classes, and evening DJ sets throughout the week

Northwest Mist.name: Northwest Mist
Northwest Mist.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Portland World famous misting tent that is like walking into a rain forest on playa. Where we come together to provide a cool oasis for dusty travelers. We open before event opening so that the builders of our great city and art have somewhere to cool off, regenerate and talk to other builders. Contact

Nose Fish.name: Nose Fish
Nose Fish.description: Hometown: Mountain View, CA Come get coffee from an undisclosed appendage of the Nose Fish itself Monday, Tuesday, and Thursday mornings and stay for the music! This year we’re giving away cookies! Bike repair clinics are happening Monday, Tuesday mornings 10:30-12:30 and Thursday afternoon 2-4:30 Hella Halo-Halo Thursday 2-4:30 during bike repair – come get a refreshing Filipino shave ice treat!

Nova Heaven.name: Nova Heaven
Nova Heaven.description: Hometown: Tel Aviv The crew that has created Nova Heaven for the past two years are gathering together to bring “Let There Be Light”, a new art installation to playa. Come by and say “Shalom”. We love you.

Now and Then Artist Collective.name: Now and Then Artist Collective
Now and Then Artist Collective.description: Hometown: Los Gatos We are a group of artists who have worked together on many projects over the years. Our goal is to support each other so we can get our art to playa and camp together. New artists are welcome. Contact

Nudibranch.name: Nudibranch
Nudibranch.description: Hometown: Salt Lake City Mutant vehicle support camp with radical inclusion in mind.

NumbSkulls.name: NumbSkulls
NumbSkulls.description: Hometown: San Rafael, CA Support camp for NumbSkull

NYC Community Container.name: NYC Community Container
NYC Community Container.description: Hometown: New York City We Guarantee Nothing! But if you’re from the NYC/NJ area your gear probably comes to the burn on our shipping containers. Contact

NYC Deli.name: NYC Deli
NYC Deli.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: New York City NYC Deli will be be serving Seinfeld-esque laughs and scrumptious New York Deli breakfast food 10am-12pm Monday through Saturday during the Burn. Bacon Egg and Cheese is most popular but we also have vegan, veggie, kosher and gluten Free breakfast sandwich options too! Coffee and water served. Like last year: there is an air conditioned public picnic area to enjoy your m

Ocean Beach.name: Ocean Beach
Ocean Beach.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Sunnyvale Ocean Beach is a sun-soaked fever dream of surf shacks, sea creatures, and boardwalk absurdity. Join our salty circus for lobster pizza rituals, smoothie shamans, sunset cocktail ceremonies, and the infamous ode to JB’s cheeseburger in paradise. Stretch your soul with yoga, tantra, and sound healing. Play boardwalk games, ride silly rides, perform on our aerial hoops, or lou

Oceyolotl Sanctuary.name: Oceyolotl Sanctuary
Oceyolotl Sanctuary.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Tepoztlan Jaguar Temple welcomes burners for evening healing ceremonies, traditional Mexican live music, out of this world singing, legends telling and much more spiritual and fun experiences. Enjoy our special cacao, rituals and magical atmosphere!

Off the Dome.name: Off the Dome
Off the Dome.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Reno, NV Come explore & express yourself at Off the Dome! Formerly known as Freestyle Palace, Off the Dome is back in the playa Wonderland for its second decade as the original musical imagination sanctuary: the Playa Talent Incubator. Our namesake DIY Jam Dome is powered by the talent and creativity Black Rock City’s citizens. Our stage, mics & instruments are available for singing,

Ofosho.name: Ofosho
Ofosho.description: Hometown: San Francisco Good ramen, a great playa moment! Serving the ramen experience on the playa the last 12 years. Doodle or dance to deep house or minimal techno while you wait, noodlessly polaroid yourself or connect with 100s of fellow burners either noodling around or slurping an irresistible bowl of happiness (we have got you covered vegetarians!). Ofosho memorable!

Oh mi Gato Rat Cafe!.name: Oh mi Gato Rat Cafe!
Oh mi Gato Rat Cafe!.description: Hometown: san francisco Oh Mi Gato Rat Cafe, formerly known as Oh Mi Gato Hat Cafe, formerly known as Oh Mi Gato Cat Cafe, delighting your senses with a combination of Colombian coffee, relaxing yoga movements, really cool hats and Latino party vibes. Drinks, art and music. What else do you need to find your inner beast. Contact

Oh No You Didn\u2019t!.name: Oh No You Didn’t!
Oh No You Didn\u2019t!.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Santa Rosa Be our guest and get it off your chest at our playa confessional lounge, featuring libelous libations and scornful judgment by our panel of experts. Commiserate with the best as we help keep your shame in perspective. Contact

OHF- One Human Family.name: OHF- One Human Family
OHF- One Human Family.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Macedonia,Norway,England,Swiss,Spain,France,Austria,San Escobar,Florida,Michigen, From Macedonia to Florida, our camp welcomes everyone to chill in our comfortable space and recharge. Coffee and Tea offered daily along with Conch Blowing, Yoga, Jewelry making and great discussions. Come join us as One Human Family. Contact

OHM HOME.name: OHM HOME
OHM HOME.description: Hometown: Laguna Beach We are a mutant vehicle support camp. Home of Ohm Kar, Manta and Vibe Apple. Come n boogie. Take the ride.

OLYMPVS.name: OLYMPVS
OLYMPVS.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Los Angeles Olympvs is a theatrical courtyard where curiosity, connection, and sensual exploration come to life. Step inside a world of music, shadow, masks, and playful encounters where strangers become scene partners and every interaction becomes part of the story. Through immersive theater, games, and guided moments of connection, Olympvs invites wanderers to explore identity, desi

Om Skillet.name: Om Skillet
Om Skillet.description: Hometown: Los Angeles Om Skillet – serving the playa Gourmet Grilled Cheese lunches Monday through Thursday and hosting the Short Stack TuTu Tuesday dance party at 2:22pm on Tuesday since 2011.

Only mEmbers.name: Only mEmbers
Only mEmbers.description: Hometown: Chicago “Only mEmbers” bar (21 and over). Only VIPs with proof of membership are permitted. Absolutely no exceptions. Contact

Opulent Temple.name: Opulent Temple
Opulent Temple.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco Opulent Temple. Sacred Dance to world Class Music Contact

Oral Fixation.name: Oral Fixation
Oral Fixation.description: Hometown: Eugene Popsicles!! Come one, come all, to partake of our tantalizing treats!! Suckle your way through the pearly gates of bliss. We’ve doubled our offerings to maximize your oral pleasure. Don’t miss out!!

Organic Fruit & Veggie Camp.name: Organic Fruit & Veggie Camp
Organic Fruit & Veggie Camp.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Tokyo The finest fruits and veggies to wet your whistle and soothe your soul. Come have a snack and a chat and reset your mind and body. Contact

Orgy Bus Camp.name: Orgy Bus Camp
Orgy Bus Camp.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Salt Lake City Orgy Bus Camp provides a safe and clean space for play parties on the playa. All of our parties have an opening ceremony where we practice consent and boundaries, as well as a fun and interactive opportunity to meet other guests. Our parties are at 3 PM and 11 PM daily. Contact

Orphan Asylum.name: Orphan Asylum
Orphan Asylum.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Yreka Orphan Asylum is a hodgepodge crew of misfits who come together through careful planning, organization and a dash of straight anarchy to create a unique social experiment that has not been terrible yet so far. We rely on the kindness of strangers, and making them not so strange (or stranger, depending) by the end of the burn, as well as providing sanctuary to strangers on playa

Orphan Endorphin.name: Orphan Endorphin
Orphan Endorphin.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Denver Orphan Endorphin: Folding Dimensions. We are everywhere at the exact same time. Be careful what portal you open because you can change the weather just by saying it within OE. Wake up and all is different. Contact

Our Own Devices.name: Our Own Devices
Our Own Devices.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Diego Home base for Our Own Devices, a massive metal pop-up book unfolding from the playa. Swing by to talk about tall tales, engineering puzzles, and the fine art of using serious skills for deeply unserious things. Contact

Owl and the Pussycat.name: Owl and the Pussycat
Owl and the Pussycat.description: Hometown: Portland, OR We are a small but mighty group of folx whose camp is a safe, welcoming environment for all Burners. We not only value physical comfort as seen by our cozy lounge and dining space, but emotional comfort to promote connection, conversation and reflection with our fellow Burners. We also value a good time! Come by our quiet tea house where you can take pause and meditate. The

Pacific.name: Pacific
Pacific.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Oakland The underwater home of the mutant vehicle Pacific, Neptune’s Chariot. The sea themed camp is welcome to campers to relax in our underwater shade and is here to host 2 dance parties on Tuesday and Thursday. Contact

PALINKA LOUNGE.name: PALINKA LOUNGE
PALINKA LOUNGE.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Bay Area Palinka Lounge offers a welcoming respite for Burners new and old around the globe, we offer a comfortable environment for Burners to take a moment to relax, have a drink, introduce themselves, and learn about what it means to be a burner (or learn about Hungarian burners) gaining from our camp-members Burning Man knowledge. We do this not only through sharing a drink, but al

pandemonium.name: pandemonium
pandemonium.description: Hometown: los angeles kinky or jus curious ? either way we have a home for you at camp pandemonium. Where chaos becomes joy, and pain is pleasure. Home of the Flaming Heart. come enjoy some of our guided kink classes in rope, flogging /impact, and fireplay. enjoy our 2 story pyramid and grand views above the dust . swing is our lyra open 24/7. dance w djs on our intimate dance floor. meet old frie

Pandora\u2019s Lounge & Fix-it Shoppe.name: Pandora’s Lounge & Fix-it Shoppe
Pandora\u2019s Lounge & Fix-it Shoppe.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: St.Louis Our camp keeps our fellow Burners biking: our repair shop offers education, tools and parts, for bike repair. Actually we’ll help you repair just about anything, but bikes are our specialty. Bike repair is our specialty, we will teach you to do your repair. We are open 24 hrs a day with a self service shop area with tools. Contact

Paper Cranes.name: Paper Cranes
Paper Cranes.description: Hometown: San Francisco At our camp, we strive to create a home on the playa – a place where our campers feel just as excited to return after a long day as they are to dive into our interactive events. We keep it simple but meaningful: serving up PB&Js, letting our DJs set the vibe, and coming together each night for a family meal you won’t want to miss. At the heart of our tradition, we invite vi

Paralunatics.name: Paralunatics
Paralunatics.description: Hometown: Oakland Art Support Camp for Hahalua. Please come visit!

Parley.name: Parley
Parley.description: Hometown: Austin Parley is your dedicated conversation camp. Come “Parley” with us during our daily facilitated events or drop in during the day for adhoc conversations on your topic of your choice. Our mission is to facilitate meaningful conversations and bridge gaps between people who might be different from one another. The topics and framing are done in a way that everyone can have an opinion

Parliament Art Crew.name: Parliament Art Crew
Parliament Art Crew.description: Hometown: Los Angeles We are an Art Support Camp dedicated to bringing large-scale, immersive installations to life for the delight and inspiration of our community. Over the years, we’ve proudly supported projects such as COQUÍ, Feed Your Head (Man Base), Atabey’s Treasure, MÚCARO, Got Framed, and Pitirre – each one creating meaningful, shared experiences on the playa. Contact

Patsy\u2019s Hangout.name: Patsy’s Hangout
Patsy\u2019s Hangout.description: Hometown: Sacramento Patsy’s Hangout is a fabulous lounge in the gayborhood where you can connect with old friends and make new ones while enjoying refreshing beverages. Enjoy high-energy tunes, good company and a comfortable space all day, every day. Stop by for our daily recurring activities including: Patsy’s Classical Morning Brew: Serving coffee and tea with classical chill music every mornin

Penny Smashing Point.name: Penny Smashing Point
Penny Smashing Point.description: Hometown: Los Angeles, Russia, Ukraine Bring your dusty body to our camp, Smash a penny like a champ. Add a chain, a clip, a hook, Wear your keepsake on the playa—take a look. Paint your body, be the art, Leave with magic you helped start.. Contact

People of Color Camp.name: People of Color Camp
People of Color Camp.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: New York Bringing COLOR to the playa since 2014! The People of Color Camp is what happens when The Muppet Show gets put in the same telepod as an episode of The Fresh Prince of Bel Air, MTV’s The Real World and a debate at the United Nations. We provide opportunity for BIPOC Burners to not only learn about and experience Burning Man, but make it our home. We bring the diversity of our

People\u2019s Art Congress.name: People’s Art Congress
People\u2019s Art Congress.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Reno The People’s Art Congress is an open salon of art, ideas, and unexpected conversations on the playa. Wander in for shade, interactive art, and workshops exploring everything from neuroscience and philosophy to creative expression and community connection. Our camp regularly hosts art gatherings, movement sessions, and evening happenings that invite participation and curiosity. Ou

Pepperland.name: Pepperland
Pepperland.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Sacramento, California Pepperland is your Playa home for the newbie and the veteran. We are a mellow camp with a Beatles vibe that will send you on a Magical Mystery Tour. We have a lot of workshops we do in camp, so many to choose from! You can also just stop by and relax in the Octopus’s Garden and chill out! Contact

Petaled Portal.name: Petaled Portal
Petaled Portal.description: Hometown: Ventura We are an Art Support Camp for Petaled Portal, a stained glass mosaic on playa.

Phantasmagoria Camp.name: Phantasmagoria Camp
Phantasmagoria Camp.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Russia and Mexico Escape to our 3-story temple with breathtaking views , sipping on our signature cocktails crafted with love. Unwind in our shady oasis, designed to rejuvenate your body and soul on hot desert days. Join us for sunset weddings every day, and groove to our daily music program featuring a unique sound system —. Come recharge and find your vibe with us! Contact

PhoCureBurn.name: PhoCureBurn
PhoCureBurn.description: Hometown: Washington DC PhoCureBurn is a Vietnamese-inspired café serving comfort food to the citizens of Black Rock City. We believe food has the power to bring people together and foster a sense of community. Our goal is to create a welcoming space where burners can connect, share stories, and form lasting memories—whether over an iced (!!) coffee or a steaming bowl of pho. Contact

Phonic Bloom.name: Phonic Bloom
Phonic Bloom.description: Hometown: Boulder Join us to experience a sound-reactive light show. Sing, play instruments, or just relax and enjoy a synesthesia-inspired experience in a relaxing and intimate environment.

Pickle Joint.name: Pickle Joint
Pickle Joint.description: Hometown: Los Angeles Downtown Black Rock City’s favorite magical little hole in the wall. Serving our world famous Pickle-Tini Cocktail since? errp? too long. Let’s say well over a decade. Always a sumptuous groove on our dance floor?.or maybe a Led Zeppelin Kazoo orchestra.

PickleBack Mountain.name: PickleBack Mountain
PickleBack Mountain.description: Hometown: San Francisco Come by and enjoy our homemade Pickle Back Juice at our Pickle Back Bar. Come through our Saloon Doors in Space, mosey on up to bar, throw down a Pickle Back! Then, for the daring, jump on Gherkin our famous Bucking Pickle for the buck of your life!

Pickleback Oasis.name: Pickleback Oasis
Pickleback Oasis.description: Hometown: Wentzville Take a break from the hot sun and stop in for a cold Pickleback. Relax and meet new friends under our shade structure.

Pilov\u2019s House.name: Pilov’s House
Pilov\u2019s House.description: Hometown: Dallas The private location of world famous Pilov. After many years on the playa, Pilov has decided to build a spectacular house on some of the finest dirt in the land.

Pinhole Project.name: Pinhole Project
Pinhole Project.description: Hometown: San Francisco Come create large format pinhole photography to capture art installations and the community in the desert! We have built a darkroom every burn since 1999. We host art-making workshops every morning. We take the workshop on an art tour using old-school pinhole cameras loaded with photographic paper. This allows participants to slow down, observe their surroundings more close

Pink Heart.name: Pink Heart
Pink Heart.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Diego Pink Heart welcomes all Burners with open arms and open hearts! Whether you’re seeking refreshment, connection, or a moment of reflection, our camp is here to nourish your body, mind, and spirit. Rehydrate with ice-cold water, indulge in our beloved vegan coconut ice cream (served Tuesday and Wednesday from 1—4 PM), or unwind with soothing buffer massages at our Vibration St

Pink Lightning.name: Pink Lightning
Pink Lightning.description: Hometown: Honolulu Pink Lightning is the home of the Burning Man Ultramarathon, and all things running at Burning Man: the 5k, the beer mile, the naked mile, easy mile, and more! Come to run an event or support an event. We also love all things PINK!

Pink Mammoth.name: Pink Mammoth
Pink Mammoth.description: Hometown: San Francisco We create an inclusive environment of love, compassion, connection, and self expression through dance, both on and off the playa.

Pink Ponies.name: Pink Ponies
Pink Ponies.description: Hometown: Portland Pink Ponies is a diverse collection of kind and welcoming queer campers. We curate and host events and workshops that celebrate queer joy. We pride ourselves on being a great place for all campers to meet and mingle the first Sunday night at our Queeer Homecoming. We also offer daily workshops on a variety of topics close to our community’s heart. We celebrate randomness, and an

Pink Squirrel.name: Pink Squirrel
Pink Squirrel.description: Hometown: Vancouver, WA Ever catch yourself daydreaming about playing table tennis, diving into a ball-pit, belly-flopping onto a trampoline packed with giant pink plushies, casually shredding on the drums, hunting for acorns like it’s a competitive sport, napping like a zen jedi, dropping beats as DJ Nuts, and sipping pink cocktails at a squirrel-themed tiki bar, all the while absolutely everythi

Pinky Swears.name: Pinky Swears
Pinky Swears.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco We are the art support camp for Looking Up Arts. We design and fabricate art in San Francisco, CA. Our camp is open to teaching and mentoring art fabrication skills, and we accept new members through late July, depending on space. Contact

Pirate Camp.name: Pirate Camp
Pirate Camp.description: Hometown: Jackson Pirate Camp is a diverse group of experienced burners providing Black Rock City with the finest frozen alcoholic refreshments. Are you too hot and parched to go on? Looking to make new friends? Stop by any afternoon from 1-4pm and hoist a mug with the Pirates. Margarita, Mai Tai, Daiquiri or Pina Colada.

Placement HQ.name: Placement HQ
Placement HQ.description: Placement HQ is the official location of the Placement office on playa. We are at Esplanade & 5:45 – stop by to get in touch with your placers, to check in for a PEERS shift, or just to say hi! Contact

planet wood collective.name: planet wood collective
planet wood collective.description: ⛺︎ Campers: designers, architects, and engineers in the built Environment. Focus on the development of low-carbon infrastructure and living in Black Rock City. Give back to the community by sharing knowledge from yearly experimentation and iterations.

Planned Playahood.name: Planned Playahood
Planned Playahood.description: Hometown: San Francisco We offer “second aid” services including contraceptives, pregnancy tests, and hygiene products and a Menstruation Station to help you stock up on your needs. Pay homage to Our Lady of the Shaven Beaver, where you can experience your playa rebirth. climb our tower or use the couch swing, get a faux-scription from our camp ‘doctors’ for whatever ails you, and visit The Museum

PLAYA 54.name: PLAYA 54
PLAYA 54.description: Hometown: Palm Springs We are a Dance Theme Camp located in the Tokyo sector playing the best Progressive & Melodic Techno. Come help build magical chaos with our new interactive art! LET’S DANCE in the Dust Together!!

Playa Agora.name: Playa Agora
Playa Agora.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Denver A vibrant space of connection, curiosity, and community. We host a full week of interactive workshops, coffee, and sangria, designed to spark conversation, inspire creativity, and bring people together. Come learn, share, and laugh with us as we co-create something meaningful at Burning Man 2026.

Playa Alterations.name: Playa Alterations
Playa Alterations.description: Hometown: Baja California Sur Playa Alterations is your one-stop shop for chopping, cropping, bedazzling, sprucing, or painting up your favorite duds! We have shade, sewing supplies, outfit ideas, and tunes to carry you through your week.

Playa Art Park Support.name: Playa Art Park Support
Playa Art Park Support.description: Hometown: Oakland A camp to support the Playa Art Park, a place to enjoy smaller art in a cozy setting. Contact

Playa Choir.name: Playa Choir
Playa Choir.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Gladstone Playa Choir is a performance art piece open to all participants. Come and join us for a rowdy, spirit-lifting musical experience! Radical Inclusion, no audition required! Singers of all skill levels, ages and persuasions are welcome! Also seeking musicians, dancers and aerialists. Rehearsals are Tuesday through Saturday 10:30 a.m. to 1:00 pm. Join us on the risers or just co

Playa Circuit Boogie.name: Playa Circuit Boogie
Playa Circuit Boogie.description: Hometown: San Francisco, Seattle, Portland Here at Playa Circuit Boogie we use circuits and science to spark ideas and bring strangers together, all while jamming out to groovy tunes and enjoying a cold beverage from our bar. Come learn the basics of soldering and circuit building; ride away with your very own light-up pendant and the skills to make an even better one next year. And bring us your

Playa Delicacies Cooking School.name: Playa Delicacies Cooking School
Playa Delicacies Cooking School.description: Hometown: sparks nv Playa Delicacies cooking school is an interactive learning experience

Playa Glass.name: Playa Glass
Playa Glass.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Boston Would you like to make jewelry from the playa dust? Grab a pair of welding goggles and harness the energy of the sun to melt the playa into glass. We provide the instructions, tools, and supplies, you cast your artistic aspirations into glass.

Playa Info/VRT.name: Playa Info/VRT
Playa Info/VRT.description: Hometown: Gerlach, NV Look for the Blue “I” in the sky near center camp! Providing Oracles, Digital Services, Lost and Found, ASL, Health Permits and BRC Lockout and Towing Services. Open 9am-6pm daily with limited services 8 am-11am on Sept. 2 Contact

Playa Jazz Cafe.name: Playa Jazz Cafe
Playa Jazz Cafe.description: Hometown: SAN JOSE A celebration of Jazz Music featuring nightly concerts and jam sessions, daytime educational workshops, and a lively bar serving coffee and cocktails. Contact

Playa Peace Project.name: Playa Peace Project
Playa Peace Project.description: Hometown: San Francisco Playa Peace Project is a global movement of artists, dreamers, and doers — united by music, generosity, and the spirit of adventure. We’re a theme camp and international sound collective that brings music, art, and magic to the playa and beyond. We support emerging artists and bring them to Burning Man for the first time. We are San Francisco based. Contact

Playa Pete\u2019s Plaza.name: Playa Pete’s Plaza
Playa Pete\u2019s Plaza.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Alameda We built a ship that doesn’t float to sail on a lake that isn’t there. Contact

Playa Piano Bar and Lounge.name: Playa Piano Bar and Lounge
Playa Piano Bar and Lounge.description: Hometown: Reno Playa Piano Bar and Lounge will be featuring live collaborative musical performance along with refreshing beverages every afternoon except Friday and Saturday. Come by Tuesday for Tutu Tuesday Tacos and Tutus from 12-2pm Come by SaturdayFor Pizza Pockets and Music from 12-2 Cocoa and music at sunset Monday to Friday at 8 PM

Playa Pinups and Fine Art Fatales.name: Playa Pinups and Fine Art Fatales
Playa Pinups and Fine Art Fatales.description: Hometown: Logan We are a camp consisting of Photographers, Models, Muscians and Artists dedicated to capturing the beauty and diversity of the citizens of Black Rock City, while offering an opportunity to enhance personal expression through the creation of several types of art.

Playacuda.name: Playacuda
Playacuda.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Los Angeles Home base for Playacuda, a mutant vehicle roaming the playa in search of connection and good energy. We offer a laid-back spot to pause, cool down, and meet fellow travelers. No schedule, no pressure, just spontaneous moments and open invitations. Swing by and you might end up on your next adventure.

PlayaDough.name: PlayaDough
PlayaDough.description: Hometown: Toronto Are you a burner hungry in body and in spirit? PlayaDough will treat you to delicious dumplings, vodka and unsafe doses of eastern european nihilism.

PlayAground.name: PlayAground
PlayAground.description: Hometown: Healdsburg We are playground with radical swings, shade, lounge, bar, games, music & art.

PLAYGROUND.name: PLAYGROUND
PLAYGROUND.description: Hometown: San Francisco Playground is a dynamic oasis set in the heart of Black Rock City, designed to draw in the curious and reward the adventurous. Alive with immersive sound, striking visuals, and a continuous flow of music, it offers a space where participants can pause, connect, and engage. From fire-lit nights to rhythm-filled days, Playground blends energy, artistry, and atmosphere into a

plop!.name: plop!
plop!.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Washington DC Welcome to our wild and whimsical dancefloor in the shade, where the vibes are as sexy as they are hilarious! Picture a vibrant space filled with young, adventurous souls ready to unleash their inner party animal. plop! is a playground of creativity, featuring DJs spinning the hottest house & techno beats that will keep you dancing until the sun goes down. Costumes are a

PlovKraft.name: PlovKraft
PlovKraft.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Burbank We cook delicious PLOV and serve it together with crazy music on the UFO stage! Contact

PLUR Pups.name: PLUR Pups
PLUR Pups.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco Human Pup Play (no bio-pups involved!) is a role playing activity that brings play, immediacy, and unconditional affection back to adult life. It came from queer kink culture, but any adult can join! Get on all fours, bark at your friends, play fetch, wag your tail, or just take a nap in a blissful dogpile. The PLUR Pups doghouse is your headquarters for pup culture on t

PO9.name: PO9
PO9.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Mesa We connect you with the world, we are the original way to get USPS mail to the playa, as we have been for decades. We do: USPS to the Playa, Playa to any (international) address with a unique artistic postmark! (US postage encouraged/required), and friendly (and not-so-friendly) posties: stand in line, and fill out your form… in triplicate… with crayon. Contact

PolyParadise.name: PolyParadise
PolyParadise.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Phoenix Arizona PolyParadise has been influencing the Hearts & Minds and Washing the Bodies of Playa Citizens from ‘2:00 – 10:00’ since 1999 celebrating 28 years in BRC in 2026. Polyamory involves openness to multiple loving relationships, with honesty among all partners. We welcome ALL Poly & Poly Friendly folks to camp within our borders. PolyParadise 2026 welcomes the Twisted Swan

Pookah Lounge/SNAFUBAR.name: Pookah Lounge/SNAFUBAR
Pookah Lounge/SNAFUBAR.description: Hometown: Los Gatos Pookah Lounge is a legendary dusty Burner hideaway glowing with Christmas lights, hookah, art, music, and excellent humans. Thrills and chills await but the best part is YOU. Come in and stay awhile. SNAFUBAR (the Better Beverage Bar) is an irreverent MASH-style camo-netted field bar for dusty wanderers in need of hydration and questionable advice. Stay in school – we’ll mix yo

PopoVille.name: PopoVille
PopoVille.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Luis Obispo PopoVille is your local watering hole with an artisitc twist please come enjoy our excellent “M” cocktails and enjoy chilling out in our grafitti zone Contact

Pops and Drops.name: Pops and Drops
Pops and Drops.description: Hometown: Kelowna Join us in our welcoming 20×30 lounge tent for cool relief and good vibes. We gift refreshing frozen popsicles while live DJs spin rotating sets throughout the day. Relax on grass turf and Moroccan rugs, sink into comfy seating, dance, chat, or just unwind in our shaded, cozy space. Open afternoons Monday through Thursday – all burners welcome to linger and enjoy. We prioritize r

Popsicle Bahrrr.name: Popsicle Bahrrr
Popsicle Bahrrr.description: Hometown: Twin Cities Ahoy matey! Welcome to Popsicle Bahrrr, a pirate- and beach-themed camp where sun-weary seafarers gather for friendly parley over ice-cold popsicles. Drawn in by the beacon of our lighthouse and music from DJNEW, wanderers can find respite from the desert heat beneath our shade canopy and relax in the Popsicle Bahrrr lounge. Inside, guests can unwind on inflatable seating whi

Potty Project.name: Potty Project
Potty Project.description: Hometown: Corvallis Home of the Potty Project a group of volunteers helping teach LNT at the potties and make the potties fun! We offer volunteer shifts M-F of the event so stop in to sign-up!

Powder Palace.name: Powder Palace
Powder Palace.description: Hometown: Meadow Vista Bringing a winter chill to the Playa and looking forward to sharing some of our winter delights. Come by for snowshoe races and our apres-ski dance party!

POWERHOUSE.name: POWERHOUSE
POWERHOUSE.description: Hometown: Portland PowerHouse is the on-Playa home of the Sunbelt Rental Power and Heavy Equipment service teams for Burning Man DPW and dozens of Theme Camps. Contact

Practice Camp.name: Practice Camp
Practice Camp.description: Hometown: Kaua’i, Hawai’i Practicing Burning Man in all the best ways! Come by for our daily Practices from arty to farty. Interact and make art with the truly unique Exquisite Dorks . Come see how practice makes camp! Exquisite Dorks is a collaborative art piece that takes the surrealist game of “Exquisite Corpse” and makes it 1000 feet long. It will be possible for thousands of people to partici

Prairie Kids.name: Prairie Kids
Prairie Kids.description: Hometown: Fargo We are the Prairie Kids, The Mutant Vehicle Support camp for the Astral Plain.

Pranksters in the Pines.name: Pranksters in the Pines
Pranksters in the Pines.description: Hometown: South Lake Tahoe / Reno / Las Vegas Brought to you by the Merry Pranksters… A nice blend of art, life, and Laughter. Dont be a Dullard, come have some laughs. Contact

Preservation Society.name: Preservation Society
Preservation Society.description: Hometown: London Preserving what has been lost. Our luscious green garden is your oasis in the desert. Our events refresh you with music and dance. Our bar serves potent potables with preserves from all the corners of the world from which our camp hails.

Pretty Pickle.name: Pretty Pickle
Pretty Pickle.description: Hometown: Thornton A relaxed and welcoming outpost on the dusty road to nowhere. We have daily afternoon pickle service (Noon to 3 pm). Cold pickles and pickletini shots! We invite passersby to step under our shade, enjoy a refreshing treat, and ride our disco pickle swing! In-the-know visitors may inquire about our playa-famous pickle warmers! Contact

Prismaticamp.name: Prismaticamp
Prismaticamp.description: Hometown: Tacoma Various artists coming together to offer LED knowledge, personal reflection experiences, dice games, & good vibes.

Pussy Avalanche.name: Pussy Avalanche
Pussy Avalanche.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Gulf Coast In spite of what degenerates might think on first read – Pussy Avalanche is all about cats. Like cats, games, books, or dorky references? Welcome home. Contact

Pussy Day Spa.name: Pussy Day Spa
Pussy Day Spa.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Redwood City If there is one “must do” at Burning Man, it’s a visit to the Pussy Day Spa. We offer a choice of refreshing body wash and pussy massage including happy ending. What’s not to like? Pleasure and bliss awaits as we pamper and delight you. Your boundaries will be respected, your feedback / adjustments encouraged, and your wishes fulfilled. We guarantee it will be the best ex

Putt Putt Palace.name: Putt Putt Palace
Putt Putt Palace.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Los Angeles Putt Putt Palace hosts a, 24/7, glow in the dark miniature golf corse and holds daily tournaments. Come stop by for our early am coffee bar and our open every afternoon Putt Putt Bar where we serve both spirits and non-alcoholic beverages.

Quarks and Recreation.name: Quarks and Recreation
Quarks and Recreation.description: Hometown: Berkeley Games for Progress! Play! Scientists vs. Valkyries! Discover! Nuclear Fusion Bocce-Golf! Learn! The modern wonders of the Atomic Age! Your local Quarks and Recreation department invites you to experience our comprehensive catalog of nuclear-inspired games, physics trivia, labyrinthian bureaucracy, and definitely-not-radioactive “drinks” at the elusive h-bar. (Void where the stro

Queertirement.name: Queertirement
Queertirement.description: Hometown: SF Queer Retirement Community – Hang with the queer playa elders, drink lemonade, bring magic, love, and gifts and receive great wisdom.

Rabbit Hole.name: Rabbit Hole
Rabbit Hole.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Concord It’s whatever you want it to be! Contact

Raccoons.name: Raccoons
Raccoons.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Vilnius, San Mateo, Kaunas, Madrid, Kyiv, L.A. Well, as the loveliest trash pandas, we firmly believe that sustainability, alternative energy sources, as well as the 4Rs (Reuse, Reduce, Rethink, Recycle) are crucial in our daily human (and raccoon) lives. A raccoon can be crafty and resourceful, responsible and playful, but above all?curious and friendly. Contact

Raditude.name: Raditude
Raditude.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Fallbrook A collective of Lucid & Light lucky individuals serving up Rad-Attitude Adjustments every DAWN & DUSK with a themed streetside Fireplace Art Piece and an Axis Mundi Reali-Tea Lounge; shoe-free shade and more for all those building, volunteering, and interacting within Black Rock City! Contact

Ragnarokk.name: Ragnarokk
Ragnarokk.description: Hometown: Denver Ragnarokk is the End and the Beginning. It tells a story where destruction is necessary for creation to flourish. It is rebirth, it is recovery, it is rejuvenation, it is a renaissance, it is renewal, restoration, and resurrection. It is what we are experiencing in our lives right now. It is Burning Man. And now, it is us. We are camp Ragnarokk!

Ranger Headquarters.name: Ranger Headquarters
Ranger Headquarters.description: Hometown: Black Rock City Black Rock Ranger Headquarters ? The center of Black Rock Ranger Operations. Located on the Esplanade at 6:35. Contact

Ranger Outpost Berlin.name: Ranger Outpost Berlin
Ranger Outpost Berlin.description: Hometown: Black Rock City Ranger Outpost Berlin – The Black Rock Ranger Station in the 3:00 sector where participants in need of assistance can seek out the help of a friendly Black Rock Ranger. Located at 3:00 and C. Contact

Ranger Outpost Tokyo.name: Ranger Outpost Tokyo
Ranger Outpost Tokyo.description: Hometown: Black Rock City Ranger Outpost Tokyo – the Black Rock Ranger station in the 9:00 sector where participants in need of assistance can seek out the help from the Black Rock Rangers. Located at the corner of 9:00 and C. Contact

Ray\u2019s Fix It.name: Ray’s Fix It
Ray\u2019s Fix It.description: Hometown: Summersville, WV Break something? We’ll try to fix it! No promises, other than you’ll leave with something and we’ll have a good time trying. Power tools and expertise available Office Hours, otherwise 24/7 DIY with hand tools, work space, and plenty of materials to MacGyver your issue. Bikes are DIY only, nor do we have mutant vehicle help, though we’ll try to point you in the right dir

Ready Playa One.name: Ready Playa One
Ready Playa One.description: Hometown: Los Angeles A world that we dream up, believe in, and step curiously into, together in Black Rock City. Each day is an adventure to expand our minds, deepen human connection, and creatively challenge the status quo’s of the world that we believe in changing. Contact

Rebel Camp.name: Rebel Camp
Rebel Camp.description: Hometown: Denver ESD Support Camp Contact

Recycle Camp.name: Recycle Camp
Recycle Camp.description: Hometown: Oakland CRUSH IT w/the Recyclenauts at Recycle Camp. Find us at our new location, 5:35 and just off the Esplanade. Bring us your mesh bags full of empty aluminum cans & ride the amazing bicycle powered Crushing Machine – The Crushinator! (plz no tin/steel/glass/plastic/trash) Contact

Red Nose District.name: Red Nose District
Red Nose District.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Bend OR Red Nose District (RND) has been in existence, in one form or another since 1998. In 2013, we resolved to keep our hearts, minds, and noses RED from now until the end of time! RND has roots and participants in LA, SF, Santa Fe, NYC, Las Vegas, Pacific NW, Canada, Israel, France, & various states & countries around the world. Our members are involved in (or are lovers of) the c

Red Rooster Ranch.name: Red Rooster Ranch
Red Rooster Ranch.description: Hometown: Reno The Red Rooster Ranch art car celebrates the fun and frivolity of Nevada’s tawdry past and present association with saloons and Cat Houses. Come join us for a ride and enjoy a libation in our tiny saloon!

Redhanded.name: Redhanded
Redhanded.description: Hometown: San Francisco Has your period caught you red-handed? We’ve got your back! Stop by our elegant Victorian period lounge for refreshing drinks (N/A options available), and precious period supplies while enjoying fun live events. Got dust in curious places? We’ll help you freshen up sustainably. Need extra care? We offer support when you’re bleeding or just having a tough day. Oh, and we’ve

RedNeck Regal Theatre.name: RedNeck Regal Theatre
RedNeck Regal Theatre.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Reno Total white trash movie nights; complete with our best white sheet hanging for a screen. BYOLC (Bring Your Own Lawn Chair) or blanket. What will be showing? WHO KNOWS? Maybe it’s a musical night? Maybe it’s a black and white version of Creature from the Black Lagoon? Maybe its cartoons! We make no promises. All we promise is that it’s an outdoor community movie screening at its b

ReEntry Station.name: ReEntry Station
ReEntry Station.description: Hometown: Tulum A calm, low stimulation space designed for participants returning from deep playa. As you make your way back into the city, step into a shaded environment offering cold water, electrolytes, and a place to pause and reset. We provide a soft landing from the intensity of the playa. No loud music, no pressure, just a welcoming space to reorient, cool down, and reconnect before continu

Religious As Fuck.name: Religious As Fuck
Religious As Fuck.description: Hometown: Sacramento A mix of Christian clergy, lay people and friends who want to bring a wide open welcome to BRC citizens, as they wish. Our mission is to offer affirmation, blessing, and spiritual support to Burner folx through Christian sacraments, ritual, prayer and conversation. We provide decomodified and non-judgy Christian spiritual practice and hospitality. Contact

Renewables For Artists RAT HQ.name: Renewables For Artists RAT HQ
Renewables For Artists RAT HQ.description: Hometown: Washington, DC Provides information and resources to artists and camps to support on-playa solar renewable power installations. Ditch the generator, rely on the sun! It is easy, and we are here to help. Visit us on playa to learn more about playa solar solutions, from tiny projects to the Temple. Enjoy a refreshing freezy pop or cup of tea while you rest in our shady lounge. Read up on b

Reno Housewives.name: Reno Housewives
Reno Housewives.description: Hometown: Reno Costuming BRC since 1998. Looking for the perfect outfit for that party? ASK US — From frumpy to fabulous, we have you covered. Contact

Resonance.name: Resonance
Resonance.description: Hometown: California, Indonesia, Australia, Mexico An art support camp for the Resonance Tree which is a large-scale immersive art installation made entirely of bamboo, designed and built by Resonance Studio. It responds to sun, shadow, sound, and movement. Rising seven meters above the playa, the Tree invites people to enter through woven roots, climb through the trunk, rest in canopy nets, and g

Retrofrolic.name: Retrofrolic
Retrofrolic.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Stagecoach An adult destination offering multiple features located within the 7:30 Red Light District. — A 1800 sq ft supervised public dungeon playspace — A 2000 sq ft public shade porch. — A suspension point between our twin-towers for flying pole, Lyra, yoga silks and Shibari demos. — Morning coffee with Mayor Angus — Daily class to explore your sensual, bondage, and sexual desires

Reverbia.name: Reverbia
Reverbia.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Eugene, OR An All Live Music Camp with 4 stages, including: The Cosmic Dome (LED interactive) The Jam and Teahouse, The Phoenix Rising Shade Stage, and Reverbia Main Stage. Reverbia features Daily: Calm Inside (breathe, Stretch) ,Live Music Yoga in the Morning…Dance Workshops, Open Mic/ Songwriter Showcase, Concerts in the Shade, Reverbia Classical Music Sunsets and Live Nights, The R

rEVOLUTION.name: rEVOLUTION
rEVOLUTION.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Los Angeles A camp of old and new friends. We believe that through evolution, we can create a revolution. We reserve the right to change, to be agents of change and to commit to the Burning Man principles each time we return after our revolution around the sun. We offer food, beverages, healing through Gamma Breath Work, opportunities to communicate with anyone and fun through dance.

RhythmWave.name: RhythmWave
RhythmWave.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: OLYMPIA Where the dust meets the soul. We provide a 2,000-square-foot barefoot sanctuary dedicated to the art of Conscious Dance. Utilizing a sprung bamboo floor beneath a cooling canopy, we host daily facilitated ‘Waves’ that invite participants to shed their playa personas and dance their inner truth. This is not a place to be seen; it is a place to be felt. We offer the tools to mo

RIPPERS ROW.name: RIPPERS ROW
RIPPERS ROW.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Austin, New York, Los Angeles, Dallas, Miami A high-energy music and dance theme camp bringing the heat from sundown to sunrise. Based out of Austin, TX, we host DJs and artists from around the world on a proper dance floor built for one thing: getting loose with strangers who are about to become your people. Each event is a full production experience with sound and lights worthy of t

RIPPLE.name: RIPPLE
RIPPLE.description: Hometown: Issaquah, WA The Ripple Effect reflects on the very nature of affecting change: how one small stone tossed into a body of water causes a ripple effect with an almost never-ending forward motion. Camp Ripple is all about tossing those positive stones to impact your own life and those of others one small metaphorical pebble at a time! Contact

Roadside Distraction.name: Roadside Distraction
Roadside Distraction.description: Hometown: Carbondale, Colorado Roll up for a hub of spectacular sidetracks and childlike wonder! With renowned attractions in our Chamber of Wonders, including the soul-searching experience of Burning Man’s Darkest Room, fun spins on classic carnival games, and a whimsical Gift Shop, there’s something for everyone at Roadside Distraction. Contact

Roasted Breauxs & Coffee Heauxs.name: Roasted Breauxs & Coffee Heauxs
Roasted Breauxs & Coffee Heauxs.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Auburn California Roasted Breauxs & Coffee Heauxs Coffee Roasting on the Playa & serving pour over coffee in BRC since 2011. We serve single origin coffee Mon/Wed/Fri 11-2PM We will focus on reducing our carbon footprint in BRC

ROCA.name: ROCA
ROCA.description: Hometown: Truckee Make a Rock. Take a Rock. Leave Your Mark.

Rocket \u2018n Roll.name: Rocket ‘n Roll
Rocket \u2018n Roll.description: Hometown: Lotus Rocket ‘n Roll mutant vehicle support camp Contact

Rogue Nation (SEAWeed).name: Rogue Nation (SEAWeed)
Rogue Nation (SEAWeed).description: Hometown: Seattle Ever wonder what happens when light listens? Light Echoes is an interactive LED wall that responds to your movement, sound, and presence, transforming you into a living paintbrush. Stop by during the day for a shady lounge to rest your dusty bones, or come back after dark to see the wall come alive. Join one of our workshops to create your own digital art and add it to the wall’s

Rooftop Frose.name: Rooftop Frose
Rooftop Frose.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Tucson A view at sunset with a cool refreshing drink for relaxed burners

Rootist Lounge.name: Rootist Lounge
Rootist Lounge.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Las Vegas #RootistLounge & #SirensCove are camps based on the joy of #energy, the beauty of #spiritual connection with self, and others. It’s a gathering of open-minded and like-minded individuals where friendships surround you. We are always creating new art, supporting art, art cars, and artists. If you would like to co-create with us, please email us! With a major focus on energy w

Rootpile.name: Rootpile
Rootpile.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Austin An established Theme Camp at Burning Man whose mission is to bring live Bluegrass music, Bluegrass musical instrument instruction, and Southern food and culture to the burns that we attend. We offer live pro-Bluegrass music most nights of Burn week. We are open to new members who embrace our mission and culture. Contact

Royal Honey.name: Royal Honey
Royal Honey.description: Hometown: San Carlos Art is the stored honey of the human soul, gathered on wings of inspiration and transformed into royal jelly by the contributions of many. Royal Honey is a camp with all types of bees that pollinate Playa with art, music, hugs, and love. Connect in our Canopy of Blooms, enjoy sweet nectar from our Pollination Station Bar, lose yourself in our Rabbit Hole Lounge, and waggle you

Rubber Armstrong.name: Rubber Armstrong
Rubber Armstrong.description: Hometown: Sydney For everything bad, Mezcal, for everything good as well, and if it still does not help, one and a half litres. We are a diverse solar-powered camp made up of members predominantly Aussie but from all over the world, all sharing a love of Mezcal. Join us for a delicious Mezzie Margie from midday to 17:00. Contact

Rum Amok.name: Rum Amok
Rum Amok.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: New York Throughout the week, our shade structure transforms into a tropical bar with a communal open-air studio. We provide the drinks, the brushes and the pigment, you provide the inspiration and the playa magic. Whether you’re a master painter or just looking to make a mess, your strokes will contribute to our collective camp mural.

Rumpus.name: Rumpus
Rumpus.description: Hometown: Boulder Morning cereal, crafts and remedies, fun and games, non-electronic beats, and a chill bar.

Rustic WerQ Ranch.name: Rustic WerQ Ranch
Rustic WerQ Ranch.description: Hometown: Austin A camp full of folx who support all artists that make the many art projects happen on playa. Drop by for a whiskey or a water between 730-930p.

SAHARAA CAMP.name: SAHARAA CAMP
SAHARAA CAMP.description: Hometown: Marrakech Trance. Tradition. Transformation. Ancestral echoes rising, From the Atlas to the Playa. Contact

Saints and Sinners.name: Saints and Sinners
Saints and Sinners.description: Hometown: Oakland Friendly easy-going camp. Kid- and family-friendly button-making and temporary tattoos most mornings. Afternoons offer opportunity to officially divorce an unwanted playa name. Afternoons also offer various adult oriented activities with topics including Shibari rope suspension to presentations on increasing enjoyment of fellatio for both givers and receivers. Someone friendly is

Sake To Me.name: Sake To Me
Sake To Me.description: Hometown: Las Vegas Sake To Me – your friendly playa servers of various chilled and flavored sake. There’s plenty of sake and chill in our shaded, cushion-ish area, plus giant Jenga and other games for all! Contact

Sakenoma.name: Sakenoma
Sakenoma.description: Hometown: Scranton High class lounge with bowling (leave your pedo billionaires at home). Providing a 4 star SAKE experience Contact

Salty Jacks.name: Salty Jacks
Salty Jacks.description: Hometown: San Francisco Your local deep dive bar and your safe-port in the storm, open daily. A nautical disco grotto with salty libations and an eclectic fleet of DJs.

San Marco Square.name: San Marco Square
San Marco Square.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco A camp of creators and community, named after Venice’s most famous public square, this is the kind of place you stumble into and then forget to leave. Come up to the Sky Bar, a fully built out cocktail lounge that hydraulically rises 15 to 20 feet above the playa, for a gifted drink and a view of Black Rock City that does not exist anywhere else. On the ground, a sprawli

Scorpion Walks.name: Scorpion Walks
Scorpion Walks.description: Hometown: Mill Valley Extraordinary Mechanical Vehicle Powered by Turbine Engine and walking on legs

Scotch & Hop.name: Scotch & Hop
Scotch & Hop.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: New York City Oh My Fur & Whiskers! You’re late! You’re late, for a very important date! Come follow the White Rabbit into our garden, where you can journey down a whimsical Acculturation Path with glowing & mesmerizing flowers & sparkly things. See where the rabbit has gone, Down The Rabbits Hole, to get some enlightenment and inspiration for your life! Enjoy our Tea Party, day or ni

Seashell Cartel.name: Seashell Cartel
Seashell Cartel.description: Hometown: Panama A tiny nautical syndicate in support of the PlayaBoot, a mutant vehicle shaped like a boot with a pineapple on top. Come for the Boot, stay for the questionable maritime affiliations. Contact

Second Rodeo.name: Second Rodeo
Second Rodeo.description: Hometown: Reno Howdy, y’all! Second Rodeo welcomes any and all participants to enjoy cheeky and fun rodeo-themed activities, offerings, and wild hoedowns! If it ain’t a party you seek, we also specialize in providing self care amenities to those seeking respite. Let us prove to you that this isn’t our first rodeo! Come as you are, every one of y’all! Yeeeeehaw!

Second Wind Pirate Cafe.name: Second Wind Pirate Cafe
Second Wind Pirate Cafe.description: Hometown: New York City We’re open from 9 PM until we feel like it. It’s a pirate-themed coffee bar serving strong black coffee. No milk, no sugar, maybe alcohol. Just bold coffee and a lot of laughs. Our pirate crew runs silly games and keeps the crowd entertained. Outside, two loud pirates with bullhorns heckle and lure people in. It’s weird, playful, and a great late-night stop. Come grab a cup

Secret Passage.name: Secret Passage
Secret Passage.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: New York City Hosts Fluffy’s Cafe of Games: 10am-10pm Mon-Sat. Infused waters, cotton candy, comfy seating, tabletop and interactive games. Hosted game show daily: Fluffy’s Feud! No need to come with a Family for this Feud, We’ll introduce you to a new family. Or, if you want to bring your crew, you can do that too! Buzz buzzers and win real prizes. Or just sit and chill. It’s all goo

Send Noods.name: Send Noods
Send Noods.description: Hometown: Denver Want to send a unique one of a kind NoodleGram? Get crafty and dive into our pool of noodles to make your masterpiece which we will hand deliver to your loved one in BRC. Limited time only, come join our team of couriers, and experience the joy of engaging in new connections! Serenity Now.name: Serenity Now
Serenity Now.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Lake Tahoe An oasis in a world of dust. Serenity Now is one of the playa’s oldest coffee shops, and for a good reason.

Servants of the Secret Fire.name: Servants of the Secret Fire
Servants of the Secret Fire.description: Been bringing dazzling LED and fire art to playa while hosting fire spinning jams and flow workshops since 2015. Come check out our library, dance to our DJ sets, or snuggle into the cuddle puddle beneath a glowing canopy of >14000 LEDs – look for the burgundy/red/orange/yellow dome!

Sha La La.name: Sha La La
Sha La La.description: Hometown: Fort Lauderdale We are SHALALA, a fun inclusive camp with little pop up events daily including wellness and Bloody Mary mornings. Espresso martini lounge evenings and specialty cocktail happy hours.

Shake, Shake, Shake.name: Shake, Shake, Shake
Shake, Shake, Shake.description: Hometown: New York City Shake your tail feather as you enjoy an ice-cold, hand-shaken cocktails on a hot playa day. Voted “the best damn cocktail bar on the Playa” by our friends and regulars!

Shamandome.name: Shamandome
Shamandome.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: New York Since 2008, Shamandome Camp has introduced the citizens of Black Rock City to Core Shamanism as described by Michael Harner and offered shamanic healing, reawakening burners to their rightful spiritual relationship with all nature. Shangri-Lounge.name: Shangri-Lounge
Shangri-Lounge.description: Hometown: Boulder Camp of amazing humans who support the Shangri-Lounge bicycle-drawn mobile martini bar. If you can find us in Deep Playa late at night, we’ll serve you the finest cocktail you’ve ever had while you relax in intimate conversation with new friends under the stars. Contact

SHANTI TOWN SOUND MOVEMENT.name: SHANTI TOWN SOUND MOVEMENT
SHANTI TOWN SOUND MOVEMENT.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Denver We strive to bring you the citizens of Black Rock City the most authentic experience in Reggae music and Sound System Culture. Delivering strictly Irie Vibes to Burning Man since day one!

Shanty Town.name: Shanty Town
Shanty Town.description: Hometown: Salt Lake City Tracked down the Up Nort Art Shanty out on the playa and ready to meet its resident troublemakers? Stop by our reception area to retrieve your commemorative postcard and learn more about our first large scale art installation. Meet the crew, explore the ecological inspiration behind the piece, and linger for connection, laughter, and a little desert mischief. Contact

Sharkey\u2019s Bar and Lounge.name: Sharkey’s Bar and Lounge
Sharkey\u2019s Bar and Lounge.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Los Angeles Sharkey’s Oasis: The unrivaled “Preferred Party Beyond the Porto-Potties, where Peni and Pagina frolic on the Pre-Playa Plaza Playground!” Our mission? To delight you with delectable libations, provide respite under our shady canopy, serenade you with tunes in the lounge, and bestow upon you exhilarating and daring drinking games! ???

Shenanigans.name: Shenanigans
Shenanigans.description: Hometown: San Francisco ICE COLD face masks! Find us when the sun is high and the heat is excessive every day. We will welcome you into our comfy chill space and put a cold mask straight from our ice packed cooler on your face. While the moisturizing ingredients soak into your skin, you’re welcome to kick back and enjoy the occasional water spritz, fanning and cup of iced tea.

Shift the atmosphere.name: Shift the atmosphere
Shift the atmosphere.description: Hometown: Atlanta Committed to spreading love and healing to the citizens of Black Rock City through guided meditation, genuine connection, emotional support and real community. Please stop by for our spiritual painting workshops, interactive music offerings, emotional release ceremonies or just to stop by and join us for coffee and matcha. Contact

Shitty Glitter.name: Shitty Glitter
Shitty Glitter.description: Hometown: New York City A boutique Bed and Breakfast providing the most luxurious hospitality experience in Black Rock City. Stop by for a rest in the clean white linens of a freshly made canopy bed (changed daily) and be sure to chat with a camp concierge to get the most of your stay. Shitty Wood.name: Shitty Wood

Shoturanga.name: Shoturanga
Shoturanga.description: Hometown: Reno We believe true connectedness isn’t found in perfect zen?it’s forged in the shaky, sweaty, deeply questionable life choices that happen somewhere between chaturanga and “why is this still plank?” This is yoga for the rest of us: the ones with wandering minds, tight hamstrings, and a running internal monologue that would definitely get us kicked out of a silent retreat. Shuttlecocks.name: Shuttlecocks

Come on by, grab a racquet and have a go! Don’t miss our Tuesday BADminton cheeky happy hour at the Outer Lounge and Thursday evening tournament where you can challenge your fellow burners. Whether you’re showing off your killer smash, whacking a few birdies,
