Side Boob.name: Side Boob
Side Boob.description: Hometown: Telluride The “side boob” has long been disparaged as trashy. But why? Come join us at Side Boob and let your side boob out on the dance floor or cuddle up with one of our camp members and share a bit of your inner “side boob” ? a part of you that you don’t always feel like you can share. We promise, no matter how trashy you think it is, we appreciate all parts of you. We are an eclectic

Sidequest Sideshow.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: New York City Clownin’ around! Contact

Signing Wanderers.name: Signing Wanderers
Signing Wanderers.description: Silence can be surprisingly loud when hands start talking. Visitors are invited to learn American Sign Language, play visual communication games, and experience Deaf culture in a lively and welcoming space. Try flirting without words, tell stories through signs, and discover how much can be said without speaking. Come join the fun and let your hands do the talking.

Silver City.name: Silver City
Silver City.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: RENO While cooling down fellow burners with delicious soft serve ice cream, and ice cold drinks. Silver City will be supplying the beats that will have peoples feet stomping and body swaying.

Simian Akademy.name: Simian Akademy

Siren\u2019s Cove.name: Siren’s Cove

We have been on many adventures across the world to Rejoice in the wondrous village that is created annually in the high desert dry lake bed. A bunch of Land lubbing Unicorn, Pony lovers and for Water lovers, Mermaids and Aquatic animals.

SIZE DOESN\u2019T MATTER.name: SIZE DOESN’T MATTER

Skinny Kitty Teahouse.name: Skinny Kitty Teahouse
Skinny Kitty Teahouse.description: Hometown: ukiah The best big, fat, kitty-loving teahouse on the playa. Come get some shade, couches and tea, tea, tea 24/7. If you come at the right time you might catch a performance, a wandering piano player tickling the keys, some aerialists, fire spinners or just some fabulous conversation at the tea bar. (Also dead things) Contact

Skrambles**!*.name: Skrambles**!*
Skrambles**!*.description: Hometown: Denver Born from chaos and tempered by confusion, now a respectable bar and lounge! Home of the best Bloody Mary on playa (accepting all challengers) and the shrine to Elijah Wood.

Skyhorse Carousel.name: Skyhorse Carousel
Skyhorse Carousel.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Altadena An amusement ride and a piece of art which celebrates human culture and cosmology from ancient to modern times, creating an experience with aspects of both art and play. SLAYER!.name: SLAYER!

Sl\u00f6M\u00f3th.name: SlöMóth

Inspired by post-modernist ideas, our camp blends curiosity, playfulness, and the irresistible pull toward brightness. Snack Shack.name: Snack Shack
Snack Shack.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Bellingham Home of The World Famous Black Rock City Hotdog Eating Contest. Floggin’ and Doggin’ since 2022 Contact

New this year is our Nail Art Station, where Burners can express their favorite Burning Man principles through creative, glitter-filled nail art. With daily tastings, playful workshops, and spontaneous f

Snark Bar.name: Snark Bar
Snark Bar.description: Hometown: Reno A Snarky experience awaits day or night, take a spin on the prize wheel if you dare! Our Dick n Ball pit awaits those that would prefer a cozy lightshow with a touch of nostalgia. Snark, shade, couches, a dome with hammocks and excellent drinks await dusty hot travelers of the day. WIFI Available – intermittently!

Snarket.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: New York The Snarket and Le Gentrifique, the snarkiest businesses in town. We got what you don’t need with a cup of coffee on the side. Millions of dissatisfied customers can’t be wrong. Come get a mouthful. Contact

Snarky Marquee.description: Hometown: La Pine Have something to say, stop by the Snarky Marquee and say it. Our snark masters will help you get the word out. Contact

Snow Chance.description: Hometown: Winnemucca, NV Christmas in the desert. Come by and get in the festive mood! Ornament making, pics with Santa and Naughty or Nice drinks.

Snow Cone Zone.name: Snow Cone Zone
Snow Cone Zone.description: Hometown: Fremont We provide Snow cones at Center Camp Monday thru Friday 12 to 3pm.

SnowKoanSolar.name: SnowKoanSolar
SnowKoanSolar.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco Snow Koan Solar serves snow cones daily, hot dogs very late at night now and then, and provides solar-based power for a number of camps in our HUB. We also have a public charging station where smaller items can be charged.

Snuggles.name: Snuggles
Snuggles.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: New York A cozy, consent-forward oasis designed for meaningful human connection. So Far So Good.name: So Far So Good
So Far So Good.description: Hometown: Los Angeles Step up to a familiar machine that offers something extraordinary. This ATM does not dispense money, but stories. Speak a memory, a longing, or a truth, and receive a small printed story shaped from your words. Come withdraw something you cannot buy. Contact

Sobremesa.name: Sobremesa
Sobremesa.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Mexico City People arrive for a drink or a taco and somehow stay for hours. Society for Temporal Preservation.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Reno The Society for Temporal Preservation consists of time travelers tasked with preserving the fabric of spacetime. Contact

SOLARIS.description: Hometown: Reno Please do not publicly list

SolarPlus.name: SolarPlus
SolarPlus.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: New York A free solar-powered community charging lounge offering e-bike, scooter, and device charging to all citizens of Black Rock City. Powered entirely by renewable energy, our shaded lounge is open daily with hosted shifts, welcoming anyone who rolls up with a dead battery. No fees, no VIP access just a genuine gift to keep Black Rock City moving.

SOLARPUNKS.name: SOLARPUNKS
SOLARPUNKS.description: Hometown: Reno We are a collective of creatives and applied technologists harnessing the power of the sun to fuel our festivities – and yours. SOLAR STATION is our gift to Black Rock City: a utility-scale clean energy power plant providing free solar energy 24 hours a day to charge theme camps, mutant vehicles, e-bikes, art support, phones, batteries, and more. Think of it as the clean energy coun

Solid City.name: Solid City
Solid City.description: Hometown: Sanford We’re mothers, daughters, siblings, and partners and maybe a cuz or two parts of a grown-ass family camp encouraging strong bonds among Black and brown Burners and their families ~ and what better way to do that than by tossing them in an ESCAPE ROOM laced with puzzles forcing you to use critical thinking skills!? If you can make it through our 90’s cityscape and out the other si

Some Camp!.name: Some Camp!
Some Camp!.description: Hometown: Lake County, CA It’s a food bank AND a cinema! Tell us your tale of woe, replace your lost food. Vegan and keto available while supplies last. Bring us your extras (e.g. water, gear, no perishables) for redistribution Grab some popcorn and stay for a movie after the sun goes down. Most to all selections subtitled/silent. We will be providing hot ramen & drinks after the burn

SomeDay Isle \u2026.name: SomeDay Isle …
SomeDay Isle \u2026.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Meadow Vista, CA Tiki Bar, Broth’l, Hammock Hangout , and Burn Barrel Gathering Space Inspiration Destination and Late Night Orientation Staytion. We will captivate you with our main event Mai Tai, You Tie, We all Tie Amateur Shibari. We offer late night fireside music, games, and chats and an always open protected lounge and hammock chill dome. Our Broth’l is a 24/7 hydration and nut

Someplace Cozy.name: Someplace Cozy
Someplace Cozy.description: Hometown: San Francisco Someplace Cozy offers a restorative sanctuary to the citizens of Black Rock City. Wander into our cozy space for mindful relaxation, physical recovery, chill beats, and deep conversations. Our air conditioned tent offers a range of daytime programming, including somatic movement mediations, mindset workshops, yoga, breathwork, and supple soul stretching. Come by at night fo

SonicBoom Saloon.name: SonicBoom Saloon
SonicBoom Saloon.description: Hometown: Provo Come enjoy some old west drinks while you learn to crack a whip or gamble your precious shwag away. Contact

Soon to be Infamous.name: Soon to be Infamous
Soon to be Infamous.description: Hometown: San Francisco Your burn is Soon to Be Infamous! Stop by and decorate a flag with your playa name and address during our Don’t Fucking Leave Your Fucking Bike on the Fucking Playa! Bicycle Flag Creation Station Events and help us end bikicide, the careless abandonment of an innocent bike to wither and die on the playa.

SophistaPirate Cove.name: SophistaPirate Cove
SophistaPirate Cove.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Salt Lake City Word travels about a Pirate port on Esplanade, a place the SophistaPirates built when they decided to make something worth staying for. During the day, it’s a place to settle in: shaded lounges, games at Kracken’s Trap, a stop at Captain Cooks, and stories shared at the Thirsty Pearl. But it doesn’t stay quiet for long. By night, the ship wakes up. Music, fire sails, an

Soul Forge.name: Soul Forge
Soul Forge.description: Hometown: San Francisco Take a deep dive into personal growth and learning – Hammer out your spirit at Soul Forge!

Soulshakers.name: Soulshakers
Soulshakers.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Bend Oregon / Queenstown NZ/ Vancouver BC Our camp is a playground for the free-spirited and a home base for nomads with a thirst for connection and adventure. We’re a global tribe of dream-chasers and boundary-pushers, supporting each other to live our best lives; from the peaks of New Zealand to the shores of Thailand, and everywhere in between. We are solid as a community and feel

SoulSound.name: SoulSound
SoulSound.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Miami Step into SoulSound, where rhythm meets ritual and every soul becomes part of the tribe. Guided by sound and spirit, we gather like modern day Vikings around the pulse of music. Move through sound journeys, tribal dance, and moments that awaken something deeper within. This is a space of strength, connection, and shared energy where strangers become family and the beat becomes y

Sound Cabin.name: Sound Cabin
Sound Cabin.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: South Lake Tahoe Welcomed to everyone to join us for rides around the playa. Just find us and jump on. Contact

SoundCloud.name: SoundCloud
SoundCloud.description: Hometown: New York Welcome to the SoundCloud, your cloud themed portal to high vibe frequencies and dreamy beats. We are a collective of sound lovers sharing music from our cozy cloud lounge. Float with us through ambient sound, deep grooves, and healing vibrations. Our crew includes sound therapists, healers, ceremonialists, musicians, DJs, and curious explorers united by a love for vibration, fr

Sozo Experience.name: Sozo Experience
Sozo Experience.description: Hometown: ALBUQUERQUE Open for those looking for inner or outer healing, and for those wanting more of the supernatural! We offer venerative and regenerative meditation, drum circles, spiritual readings, healings, and an experimental “Dopamine Dump” experience. So get some caffeinated exotic coffee with us in the morning, or come to afternoon thought provoking and interactive workshops on survivin

SP Station.name: SP Station
SP Station.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Los Angeles Home station for the SP Express mattress cabana train!

Space Bar.name: Space Bar
Space Bar.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Miami A group of humans committed to supporting art at Black Rock City. Come meet us at our art sculpture or in our open-to-all shade structure at camp.

Space Cowboys.name: Space Cowboys
Space Cowboys.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Sacramento & San Francisco, California Shakin Yo Business again on the Playa! The cowgirls and cowboys are back yet again with their version of the Wild West. Travel the playa on the Martha – An Art Car with Love & personality. Martha < 3’s you! An experience to the edge of the playa. M, Tu, W; 4p – 7p – Learn Argentine Tango All day every day – play Gigantic games in camp Put on your

Spaced Out.name: Spaced Out
Spaced Out.description: Hometown: Patras Visitors are invited to step into a creative space where they can slow down, explore, and take part in collaborative art. At the center of the camp is a large drawing installation that evolves throughout the week as participants add marks, gestures, and symbols to a shared canvas. Guided meditation to drawing sessions and informal conversations invite people to explore ideas aroun

Spanky\u2019s Wine Bar.name: Spanky’s Wine Bar
Spanky\u2019s Wine Bar.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Reno The infamous crown-jewel of Burning Man bars. We take a tongue-in-cheek approach to wine, and a paddle-to-cheek approach to your butt 😉 Contact

Sparkle Camels Costume Bazaar.name: Sparkle Camels Costume Bazaar
Sparkle Camels Costume Bazaar.description: Hometown: San Francisco Need to upgrade your playa swag? We’ve got you covered, from funky hats, tutus and sparkle bootie shorts. You never know what you’ll find. Open every day from mid-day to dusk. All are welcome!

Sparkle Love.name: Sparkle Love
Sparkle Love.description: Come experience a little Sparkle Love in our beautiful oasis Tiki lounge, enjoy a cold drink and make new friends. We are a colorful and eclectic crew of sex positive, queer friendly, Sparkle Lovers and Burning Man family with an international flair. Cold drinks, hot friends, sexy games, groovy beats, rainbow colors all around. Contact

Spec-Taters.name: Spec-Taters
Spec-Taters.description: And amidst this sea of humanity, there are potatoes. Yes, potatoes. Perhaps an unexpected sight in the midst of such a surreal landscape, but therein lies the magic of Burning Man. These humble tubers, often overlooked in daily life, take on new significance here. They’re not just food; they’re symbols of sustenance, resilience, and community.

Spoonful of Friends.name: Spoonful of Friends
Spoonful of Friends.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco A camp built around the simple idea that sharing a meal can turn strangers into something closer. We create thoughtful, beautifully hosted dining experiences that bring people together. Long tables, warm lighting, music that invites you in, and conversations that linger. Our camp is a place to connect, and participate. Some come to cook, some to serve, some to host, and

Square One.name: Square One
Square One.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Los Angeles A diverse group united in creating large-scale art through efficient and sustainable designs, inspiring individuals and other camps to burn stronger. Our efficiency-driven approach allows us to contribute more to the community. We modify and use Burning Man?centric shipping containers for our camp activities, including the B&B BBQ and our 35-foot hammock Nest tower. We ope

Squeeze the Day.name: Squeeze the Day
Squeeze the Day.description: Hometown: San Francisco Bay Area A refreshing oasis of “Ice Cold Liquid Sunshine” on the playa! Since 2016, we’ve been inviting passersby to pause for a chat & a shot of homemade limoncello. Our camp is simple: good people, tasty pours, and real connection where strangers become friends in the dust. We’re also the artists behind the Serendipity Machine, an interactive art installation designed to

Stag Camp.name: Stag Camp
Stag Camp.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Diego We invite anyone and everyone (drama-free), including singles, couples, and small groups from all walks of life. We have no strict regimen of things to do or fees to pay. Everyone contributes as much as they like, with radical self-reliance a camp cornerstone. If you’re looking for shared showers, meal plans, kitchen shifts, etc., we’re not the spot for you. We all just come

Stampede!.name: Stampede!
Stampede!.description: Hometown: Phoenix A movement and connection-driven space inviting you off your bike and into the herd. Step into a shaded lounge for yoga, breathwork, and playful, consent-forward interaction. Explore aerial, join spontaneous group moments, or simply land and connect. Come find your stripes. Contact

Star Buds.name: Star Buds
Star Buds.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Berkeley This is the dedicated heart and support for the Sanctuary of the Silent Star.. Come share a cup of tea in our cozy lounge and discover quiet clues on how to unlock the mysteries of the …. We invite you to trade the noise of the city for a moment of meaningful stillness and communal connection. Our space is a soft landing for weary travelers.

Star Jelly.name: Star Jelly
Star Jelly.description: Hometown: San Francisco, San Diego, Park City A loosely knit collection of individuals operating as a singular organism. Traveling space and time to learn and share with you all at Burning Man. Come by to enjoy our wonderlawn oasis and traverse the sparkly gates to the new you. Or enjoy some general shenanigans in our Jelly Dome. We’ll also be giving out Gold Stars, so come by to share your tales

Stardust Lounge.name: Stardust Lounge
Stardust Lounge.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco Enter an interdimensional portal that leads to a magical experience comprised of love, silliness, and sparkly things! Stardust Lounge is an eclectic pit stop for dusty travelers on their inter-playatary journeys. The three sections of the camp–the Lounge, Spa, and Wedding Chapel–offer visitors a fun blend of rituals, games, and opportunities for self-care. Contact

StarFist.name: StarFist
StarFist.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: London Infamous international tea service Mon-Sat 2-5pm serving a delightful selection of hot and cold infusions from around the world as we pamper and delight our guests. Offering a refuge from heat and dust, unparalleled hospitality and secret surprises for the lucky few. Morning meditation/yoga sessions most days at 11:11am and our fascinating evening StarFist Lecture Series, explo

StarPups.name: StarPups
StarPups.description: Hometown: Denver A daily caffeine fix of cold-brew coffee in the morning and a relaxed space to hang out at throughout the day! Play some games and make new friends in our cafe, toss some bags for cornhole, or test your coordination with giant Jenga!

Stars And Bikes.name: Stars And Bikes
Stars And Bikes.description: Hometown: Minneapolis Bike Repair! 12 to 4 pm Monday through Saturday. Professional mechanics with tools, parts, and skills to fix all your bike problems. Shaded waiting area with seating and a self-service station for those who are radically self reliant! Roll on in, both you and your bike deserve some love. Contact

Steam Bath Project.name: Steam Bath Project
Steam Bath Project.description: Hometown: Boston The original and still the best steam bath experience. Step into a world of relaxation and rejuvenation at The Steam Bath Project. Located at the heart of Burning Man, our camp offers a unique and immersive experience inspired by the soothing power of steam. Enter our tranquil oasis and indulge in the therapeutic benefits of steam bathing, surrounded by the sights, sounds, and sce

STEEP?.name: STEEP?
STEEP?.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Los Angeles GOOD JOB! You made it to Burning Man. Now come playfully question existence with us at STEEP?. Explore you inner child with games, heckling, random acts of wonder, authenticity, connection, and… DRINKS. We love them. With alcohol, without alcohol, and often featuring plant extracts and ALWAYS made with love. Come Drink in the Love at camp STEEP? ya weirdos. Contact

Stimulation Station.name: Stimulation Station
Stimulation Station.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: All Over Cali Dive into a little oasis for your nervous system at Stimulation Station. Slip on a mask and let the world fade as we guide you Monday through Friday, 12pm to 3pm, through a consent based sensory reset. Expect soothing touch with gentle tools and scratch therapy plus calming soundscapes designed to help you drop in and breathe again. Spot our bold front scaffolding and ho

Stoop.name: Stoop
Stoop.description: Hometown: Portland, OR Serving top-shelf, neighborly vibes, Stoop is a place where you belong. Our art is hosting. Welcome home! We’ve created a place for neighbors to gather, share stories, express their art, and make new friends while sipping a delicious cocktail and eating a grilled cheese, blueberry pancake, or whatever we’ve got going on the grill. Contact

Stoop City.name: Stoop City
Stoop City.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: New York City Stoop City captures the magic of a fever dream spent wandering the streets of Black Rock City. Come share a secret on our cozy stoops with a new friend, savor a steaming slurp of spicy ramen, or grab a last-minute bandaid from our Asian-inspired bao-dega. This might just be the late night corner bodega you never knew you needed.

Storytime Friends.name: Storytime Friends
Storytime Friends.description: Hometown: San Francisco Storytime and Dreamtime co-create magic. Storytime is a larger-than-life Tiffany’s banker’s lamp, building community through the magic of storytelling and reading aloud across the playa. Pick up a book, sit in a circle, and read to friends new and old. Lie back, listen, and watch the stained-glass lampshade slowly change overhead. Share your own stories, or create a new one

STRANGELOVE.name: STRANGELOVE
STRANGELOVE.description: Hometown: San Francisco Fly the Friendly! Come get your altitude and your attitude adjusted in our airliner-themed lounge, where each afternoon you can enjoy the company of your fellow jet-setters while you sip ice-cold draft beer or a signature cocktail and groove to tasty house beats at our 16-foot wing-shaped bar.

Struggletown Station.name: Struggletown Station
Struggletown Station.description: Hometown: Phoenix, AZ Struggletown Station is the depot station for The Struggle Bus artcar. Come hitch a ride with us for art tours and just exploring the amazing Playa sites and sounds. Contact

Studio and Spa.name: Studio and Spa
Studio and Spa.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Las Vegas Come to BRC Studio and Spa to not only to receive a massage or have your sensual, erotic or daring fine-art photo taken, but join one of our workshops and take some new skill back to the default word. Either way, walk away with a unique photo print, or a new skill, or at least relaxed! Contact

Suburbia.name: Suburbia
Suburbia.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Portland We are putting our efforts into bringing that same tacky suburban culture to Black Rock City. New and old burners will be able to see one of the most disgusting/ugly parts of society in the urban sprawl of the ‘default world’ displayed in a beautiful and enjoyable way. From the moment someone spots Suburbia, they will see a typical suburban neighborhood, but the with Burning

Sundowners.name: Sundowners
Sundowners.description: Hometown: New York “Sundowners” comes from a South African friendship ritual we host Monday to Friday at sunset. A safari themed art car and a South African shebeen speakeasy anchor our public offering, alongside dance and cultural programming rooted in music, movement, and social exchange. Our creative center is Afrofuturism, imagining a positive and inclusive future through speculative art and t

sunny side up.name: sunny side up
sunny side up.description: Hometown: San Francisco Art camp for burning man art installation “sunny side up”

Sunrise Tavern.name: Sunrise Tavern
Sunrise Tavern.description: Hometown: Reno Come for the bacon, stay for the sunrise. You gnome you’ll like 😉

Sunset Lounge.name: Sunset Lounge
Sunset Lounge.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Atlanta You know us and you love us. Up to our usual shenanigans .. Come find us!

Suspended Animation.name: Suspended Animation
Suspended Animation.description: Hometown: Seattle, WA Experience full-suspension erotic rope bondage: part kinetic art, part thrill ride, part endorphin rush. Our crew of expert riggers offers bondage and BDSM rides to all (Yes! You too can fly!), workshops for all levels, breathtaking performances, and night time play parties. We also rove the playa and build impromptu bondage sculpture! Contact

Swan Forest.name: Swan Forest
Swan Forest.description: Hometown: Las Vegas Swan Forest is the heart and soul of our camp, where creativity, community, and transformation come together. Named after both the Prodigal Swan and the Forest House art cars, our camp serves as a space for artistic expression, connection, and shared experiences. The Prodigal Swan, with its dynamic sound and light displays, invites exploration and interaction, while the Forest

Swing City.name: Swing City
Swing City.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Santa Monica Swing City brings the energy and vibe of the Original Muscle Beach in Santa Monica California to Burning Man. We strive to provide a safe welcoming playground that can be enjoyed by all ages. Come to participate or just hang out in our shade and watch the various acrobatics available as seasoned professionals and movement newbies alike explore our space. Contact

Swirl Support.name: Swirl Support
Swirl Support.description: Hometown: San Francisco Basecamp / garage for Chosen Yogurt.

SYMBIO.name: SYMBIO
SYMBIO.description: Hometown: Miami Drop your responsibilities at the door and check into SYMBIO. Expect playful chaos, questionable life advice, and zero supervision as you reconnect with your inner child (who probably makes worse decisions than you do). Snacks, silliness, and spontaneous magic included.

Synaesthesia.name: Synaesthesia
Synaesthesia.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Oakland A dreamworld where movement, sound, and light unite. Come play on our 26′ tower, dance to live music and DJ sets, and enjoy a refreshing beverage. Contact

Synapse Conduit.name: Synapse Conduit
Synapse Conduit.description: Hometown: Oakland CA We are Phó – Cup. Your midnight Phó restaurant Come find up in deep playa on Wednesday and Thursday night. Relax, eat and drink and then take your dusty ass out for some fun at the next shiny object!! Contact

T33M0.name: T33M0
T33M0.description: Hometown: Sydney T33MO will get you back on the track If your bike is sick, we’ll heal it for ya! If you’re low on energy, try our refreshing icy slushies while relaxing in our cozy lounge.

ta-keel-ya or ta-heal-ya.name: ta-keel-ya or ta-heal-ya
ta-keel-ya or ta-heal-ya.description: Hometown: San Diego A glowing pink disco dome invites passersby to pause and choose their own adventure! Will it be a tequila shot or a fiery wellness shot packed with ingredients like ginger and turmeric. Campmates host this simple but spirited ritual throughout the week, creating a space for laughter, conversation, and unexpected connection. Come spin through, reset your energy, and share a quic

Tac-O-Cat.name: Tac-O-Cat
Tac-O-Cat.description: Hometown: Meadow Vista We are Camp Tac-O-Cat. We cook tacos for the masses and enjoy serving libations and great conversation. We offer shade, a misty breeze and we have a few gear-heads who like to solve problems. Our camp is made up of Burners with deep roots in playa culture and a few we have newly adopted. People will likely be pulled in by heckling when they pass by, and some of the best conn

Tarwater.name: Tarwater
Tarwater.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: santa rosa Looking for Answers to All Life’s Questions? Just took for the mannequin caged in a travois: There you’ll find Lady S’s Boutique, Cut throat Bowling, The World Tree, miscellaneous games and the welcoming denizens of Tarwater. You’ll also recognize us by the crusty old Rat Taxi, parked in front. Contact

Tazii.name: Tazii
Tazii.description: Join us for rest, ease, and libations in the Tazii Moroccan Tent chill lounge 24 hours a day! Our bar is filled with pillows and rugs to get cozy with new and old friends. Swamp-cooled during the day for the perfect nap, themed cocktails in the evening to inspire a great night, and good times all the time.

Team Human Base Camp.name: Team Human Base Camp
Team Human Base Camp.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Mt. Shasta A far-flung conglomerate of artist, loonies and weirdos from California, Oregon, Texas, Indiana and Australia coming together to provide an interactive and unique space for live music, DJs, performance artist and speakers to share their offerings. Come be a character in our quirky little variety show.

Teddies.name: Teddies
Teddies.description: Themed parties, food, bar & tunes all week. Cuddle with Bears & more in the Teddy dome, open 24/7 Contact

Temple Camp.name: Temple Camp
Temple Camp.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Oakland We are the support camp for Temple of the Moon, this year’s official Burning Man Temple. We are a multinational crew of artists, builders, creators and supporters who have spent all of 2026 bringing this temple to life for our community. We welcome everyone to stop by and learn more about the process of designing and building the temple, and we’d love to hear your thoughts and

Temple Guardians.name: Temple Guardians
Temple Guardians.description: Hometown: Black Rock City Location of the Temple Guardian & Burn Perimeter training area, as well as the Temple Guardian Helpdesk. Camping for a few guardians and guardian leadership cadre. Contact

Temple O\u2019Flying Spaghetti Monster.name: Temple O’Flying Spaghetti Monster
Temple O\u2019Flying Spaghetti Monster.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Los Angeles We are a comfortable neighborhood pub with a-rockin’ attitude and groovin’ tunes. In honor of His Noodly Goodness, the Friendly Fire Bar will administer ice-cold libations for your mind, body, and spirit. We will also provide unofficial and official playa weddings in His Noodly Goodness’ Temple. Come learn about his Noodly Goodness, call almost anywhere in the world on “Ta

Temple Oasis.name: Temple Oasis
Temple Oasis.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Gerlach Temple Oasis is a decompression spot and camp for those who have gathered at, worked at, or been a Guardian at the Temple. An Oasis on the playa from the heaviness of the Temple and our service to it; a place to find others who are welcome to talk or sit in knowing silence as we unwind our experiences. Contact

Tengri Camp.name: Tengri Camp
Tengri Camp.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Almaty A glowing yurt encampment where the wind carries stories, music, and the memory of the steppe. Within warm circular shelters, strangers become guests, guests become family, sharing tea, song, and slow moments of presence under the desert sky. On Wednesday and Friday from 3 to 5 pm, we gift communal meals as gatherings of hospitality and shared tradition. By day and night, we of

Tequila Bees.name: Tequila Bees
Tequila Bees.description: Hometown: SALT LAKE CITY The Tequila Bees are a Hive Like No Other, come see what the Buzz is about Contact

Terrapin Station.name: Terrapin Station
Terrapin Station.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Humboldt County The Galactic Terrapin lives to take you on intergalactic adventures of epic proportions. You’re always “home” when you’re with us, so swing by, take a trip and find your own Axis Mundi. Contact

Terrible Turtle.name: Terrible Turtle
Terrible Turtle.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Boulder A camp at the meeting point of artificial intelligence, creative practice, and the felt sense of being alive. We bring together technologists, artists, and seekers who believe the most interesting questions about AI aren’t answered in labs, they’re answered in ritual, in conversation, in community. What happens when a machine reads your cards, or a workshop on consciousness ru

Tetrix Stargazer.name: Tetrix Stargazer
Tetrix Stargazer.description: Hometown: Sydney Home to a bunch of Aussies welcoming you to the humble abode of the Stargazer Artcar. We will be serving up daily disco coffee and snacks from 9am-12pm, so come party with us and then hop aboard the Stargazer Artcar in the evening for a journey out to deep playa from 9pm onwards Contact

The Airship.name: The Airship
The Airship.description: Hometown: Calgary A steampunk inspired bar camp that’s returning to the Playa for our third year. Our little crew of miscreants, scoundrels, and artists want to gift some fun and frivolity to the Playa in the form of themed bar night and a lounge for relaxing!

The Alphabet Cookout.name: The Alphabet Cookout
The Alphabet Cookout.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Washington, DC A welcoming neighborhood gathering space rooted in cookout culture and the joyful spirit of the Alphabet Mafia. Stop by our shaded lounge and bar to relax, meet new people, and enjoy music with a focus on house and dance traditions connected to Black and queer communities. Throughout the week we host listening sessions, neighborhood happy hours, and casual social gather

The Astral Social Club.name: The Astral Social Club
The Astral Social Club.description: Hometown: Grass Valley A home on the playa for experimental, ambient, acoustic, classical and celestial music. Indulge in our house made elixirs and tinctures at our non-alcoholic bar; let your consciousness slip through our transdimensional portal. Elevate and expand. Contact

The Back Hole.name: The Back Hole
The Back Hole.description: Hometown: Reno Nevada GPE Staff and Volunteer Camping: Where Gate goes to Sleep or recover

the black hole.name: the black hole
the black hole.description: Hometown: Black Rock City The Black Hole is a Staff Camp supporting the needs of Gate, Perimeter and Exodus.

The Carrot Club.name: The Carrot Club
The Carrot Club.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Annapolis Our camp is focused on health and happiness; health through fresh vegetables and fruits at the Black Rock Farmers Market in the mornings and happiness and festivities at the Carrot Club in the afternoons. Enjoy tasty, fresh produce to feed the body, refresh the spirit, and nourish the soul! One of the best parts of exploring any city is checking out the farmer’s market- and

The Cave.name: The Cave
The Cave.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco To deviate positively is to play with the rules, reimagine the future, build new realities, and break what no longer serves. It starts small: a question, an experiment, a new way of relating – that quietly reorganizes what’s possible between us and around us.

The Club.name: The Club
The Club.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: New York City A Joker-run casino parody where nobody wins money but everyone risks becoming part of the show. Play two games – Twenty One My Ass and Deez Roulette. Bring a joke, a story, or something strange with you. Welcome to a casino run by people who should not run casinos. Contact

The Crusty Swan.name: The Crusty Swan
The Crusty Swan.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco The best Irish Pub on the playa! Stop by for a shot of whiskey, a traditional Irish Coffee, an ice-cold tea or coffee, some friendly conversation and a dusty hug. Slainte! Contact

The Den.name: The Den
The Den.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Santa Cruz That magical place where you can explore fun and play, where you can connect deeply with a person and never see them again, where you can talk philosophy, politics, science… or just be horny! In the den, anything can happen if you want it to. Stop on by and hangout at our bar and sample our World Famous Love Puddle Punch, if you are lucky you may get a spanking from our Lov

The Dusty Nuts Tavern.name: The Dusty Nuts Tavern
The Dusty Nuts Tavern.description: Hometown: Santa Clara, CA Escape the constant wub wub for something a little different, along with dusty drinks from dusty people.

The Enclave.name: The Enclave
The Enclave.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Santa Barbara A curious arty-party space of pan-asian tones. We fuel our wonky camp with oddities of spiced grit and charm for those with deeply set Playa roots along the new rhizomes to grip in. We are united by a passion for art, design and bafoonery. The Enclave brings a spicy hot mess of Playastani energy to Black Rock.

The Fluffy Cloud.name: The Fluffy Cloud
The Fluffy Cloud.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Washington, D.C. Home of the The Fluffy Cloud! A giant 360-degree immersive sound and light installation towering 3 stories tall and equally wide, the Cloud is a one-of-a-kind art amplification platform hosting a variety of musical interactivity throughout the week. From world-class DJs to interactive jukebox nights, to sound baths, join us under the Cloud every day of the week to get

The Fountain (of youth).name: The Fountain (of youth)
The Fountain (of youth).description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco A longevity-focused camp at BM where we celebrate life and coordinate to fight aging & death. Our gifts to the playa are LongeviTEA, our signature teahouse and the Rejuvenating IV Lounge. We have healthy food (inspired by the blueprint diet), IV hydration raffles, and daily workshops on accelerating longevity, biohacking, wellness, and creating a protopia. Whether you’re

The G Spot.name: The G Spot
The G Spot.description: Hometown: Oakland The G Spot is hard to find. A surreal junkyard where anything goes, and nothing is what it seems. Rare pokemon are born here. Come for the mystery, stay for the mayhem. Contact

The G-Spot & Sloth Sinema.name: The G-Spot & Sloth Sinema
The G-Spot & Sloth Sinema.description: Hometown: Bay Area Can you find the G-Spot? We are your favorite neighborhood dive bar. Come thirsty, leave happy! New for 2024 we are shifting to an evening offering and opening the Sloth Sinema. Join us for a chill evening of great movies, themed cocktails, and of course, shenanigans! Family-friendly matinees included. Already have plans for the evening? Come by in the morning for “Saturday” mor

the Garage.name: the Garage
the Garage.description: Hometown: Topanga, Reno, San Fran, Hawaii Art support camp for “the Garage”

The GASS Co..name: The GASS Co.
The GASS Co..description: Hometown: Agua Dulce A camp of artists and fabricators quietly (and sometimes not quietly) building something strange and wonderful for deep playa. Contact

The Glorious Wet Spot.name: The Glorious Wet Spot
The Glorious Wet Spot.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Seabeck Home of the Wet Spot art car!

The Gutter.name: The Gutter
The Gutter.description: Hometown: Portland Your grungy nostalgic neighborhood bowling alley. Land marked by our towering 10-ft bowling pin, The Gutter features a one-lane bowling alley open daily for spontaneous games, wild strikes, and the occasional gutterball. Spin your way into The Spare Room, a shaded lounge and dance space, a bowling-themed bar, and a DJ booth spinning beats to keep the energy rolling. Whether you’

The Hand Lovers Lounge.name: The Hand Lovers Lounge
The Hand Lovers Lounge.description: A soft landing space for hands, lovers, lovers of hands, and everything in between!

The Hash House.name: The Hash House
The Hash House.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco Bay Area Formerly BRCH3, slings the greasy delicious carb-loaded potatos that we all know and love and much much more all served by members of The Hash House Harriers, the (in)famous drinking club with a running problem since 1938. Grab some spuds and spice them up with your hot sauce of choice from the hot sauce library. Enjoy a cold drink or a drinking challenge at our

The Institute.name: The Institute
The Institute.description: Hometown: San Francisco The Institute of higher yearning invites the dusty wanderer to expand their mind into the bottomless pit of knowledge and exploration.

The Island.name: The Island
The Island.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: TAHITI A French-speaking camp sharing the spirit of Polynesia at Burning Man. Come discover a warm and relaxing space inspired by Tahiti, with traditional monoï oil massages, cultural touches, and an inviting island atmosphere Contact

The Key Camp.name: The Key Camp
The Key Camp.description: Hometown: Tokyo The Key = Believe. We have a key for you to open any door. During our interactive event, “Fortune Key Hunting,” we will help you discover your key and guide you on how to use it to open new doors in life. After you explore your key, we will serve cold Japanese green tea and offer you a choice of a henna tattoo of your Kanji or a Kanji sticker.

The Last Starfighters.name: The Last Starfighters
The Last Starfighters.description: Hometown: Austin Greetings, Starfighter. You have been recruited by the Star League to defend the playa against commodification & moop. Your participation in supporting artists by building a branch of The Solar Library & giving home to Solarians is to be commended. Your communal effort & civic responsibility will be known across the galaxy. You as a radically self reliant creature have always want

The Lavender Lounge.name: The Lavender Lounge
The Lavender Lounge.description: Hometown: Sebastopol Welcome to The Lavender Lounge! Come in out of the sun and receive a relaxing scalp massage while we mist you with lavender scented water. Lie back on an air mattress and take a few moments to slow down and enjoy yourself. You will leave feeling fresh, alive, and with just a bit more pep in your step! Open 11am-2pm Mon-Fri Contact

The Lost Penguins.name: The Lost Penguins
The Lost Penguins.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco bay area We have been a hospitality camp on playa since 2001. We are returning this year to bring you our amazing brain-freezing snow cones, and sizzling hot entertainment! Stop by and take shelter from the hot sun, or sit out a dust storm, in our welcoming 40′ x 80′ shaded lounge. You can relax on our comfy couches, while you enjoy your snow cone or cold beverage from t

The Makers Space.name: The Makers Space
The Makers Space.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Twin falls We are an art support camp and would love to offer support to the artists and builders on playa. with help, food, drinks, materials, other resources if needed.

The Market.name: The Market
The Market.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco Imagine you are wandering through Playa on your way home from a night of adventure or just starting out in search of adventure. Your stomach growls a bit, maybe you feel just a tiny bit thirsty. From afar you see a gathering of carts, lit up and welcoming. What’s going on over there? You pedal towards it and stumble upon The Market. You are suddenly surrounded with stand

The Melon Motel.name: The Melon Motel
The Melon Motel.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Los Angeles A retro desert oasis where playful hospitality meets music and connection. Step into our motel-inspired world, check in with our crew, and become part of the experience. By day, we host a vibrant shaded lounge serving refreshing melon-based drinks and creating a social space to relax, meet new people, and recharge. Throughout the week, we also offer wellness sessions inclu

The Mystical Grill.name: The Mystical Grill
The Mystical Grill.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Buenos Aires A global circle of kindred spirits united by fire, flavor, and story. We gift two styles of traditional Argentinian Asado from our open grill and invite Burners to gather for communal meals, spontaneous storytelling, readings from our camp tarot reader, and soul warming connection. We honor food as a ritual, fire as transformation, and the Playa as our shared home. Contac

The OG Pit.name: The OG Pit
The OG Pit.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Lake Havasu The OG PIT is a little fire, a little fancy, a little filthy—but always family. We build hard, stay late, and never forget why we’re here. Whether you’re sipping morning mimosa coffee, slapping your way through a late-night meltdown, or screaming karaoke to the stars, you’re always welcome in The Pit! See you in the dust, baby.

The Organization.name: The Organization
The Organization.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco Whether you are tired and in need of energy, or simply heading out on the playa and in need of a drink, stop by our camp for an espresso martini (or simply an iced coffee or non-alcoholic beverage)! Meet and chat with fellow burners while you sit in our shade, lay down in our hammock, rest in our cuddle puddle or jump on our trampoline. Contact

The Parlour Room.name: The Parlour Room
The Parlour Room.description: Hometown: San Francisco born The Parlour Room is a classy-not-classy, heavily shady/shaded, industrial Victorian lounge space welcoming all BRC citizens to come relax under the shade with a cool beverage during the morning and afternoon or chat the night’s adventures fantastic around our fire pit in the wee hours.

The Pearly Gate.name: The Pearly Gate
The Pearly Gate.description: Hometown: Boise, New York, California, Seattle, Ukraine Your one-stop shop for the afterlife. Come find your way through your sins and salvations, walk our runway, bring out your inner Sexy Jesus and Foxy Mary, come to our fetish ball or just stop by for a drink.

The Pink Spot.name: The Pink Spot
The Pink Spot.description: Hometown: Park City, UT The Pink Spot is an art car support camp with The Big Bunny art car, Dj driven holding up to 40 burners. We will leave camp every evening around dusk, please come by for a prefunk and hop on for a thorough throw down! Contact

The Pleasure Dairy.name: The Pleasure Dairy
The Pleasure Dairy.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco Finally, what you’ve been waiting for! A Burning Man Camp that reimagines the little-known historic phenomenon of pleasure dairies! Think Marie Antoinette but in the Wild West. A place where you can never have too many cows or cow puns. At high noon be udderly refreshed by dairy-alternative craft cocktails at our bar, The Tits, and spend some time in the shade nourishing

The Shittest Camp.name: The Shittest Camp
The Shittest Camp.description: Hometown: New York City Our camp celebrates one of the most universal human experiences: poop. Through humor, art, and playful activities, we aim to normalize conversations around bodily functions and remind everyone that we all share the same basic human needs. Our camp features a toilet-themed bar, a quirky camp museum, and a variety of interactive activities including DJ sets, comedy, scavenger

The Shrimp Ranch.name: The Shrimp Ranch
The Shrimp Ranch.description: Hometown: Oakland Howdy! Welcome to the Shrimp Ranch, where the Wild West meets the salty sea. We’re a camp of new and seasoned looking to create a unique experience for the community in the only way we know how: through quirky food, music and event offerings. Our ragtag crew will transport you to an imagined past, where crustaceans roamed the frontier. Come learn the lore and embrace our culture

The Shuttle Home.name: The Shuttle Home
The Shuttle Home.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Los Angeles A welcoming tea lounge and connection space offering a calm refuge within Black Rock City. Centered around a shaded Tea Lounge, we host tea ceremonies, consent workshops, guided conversations, and intimate gatherings designed to encourage meaningful connection. Our camp invites participants to slow down, share stories, and recharge in a warm and inclusive environment. With

The Society of Supreme Excellence.name: The Society of Supreme Excellence
The Society of Supreme Excellence.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Nelson The Society (for the Pursuit) of Supreme Excellence cordially invites you to pursue excellence in all facets of existence. We’re here to support your journey towards pursuing excellence through a variety of excellent activities, including revitalising elixirs, nourishing pizza & supremely soul soothing bass.

The Sound Garden.name: The Sound Garden
The Sound Garden.description: Hometown: San Jose/ Vegas We are a high vibe sound camp here to delight your senses with a unique 360 degree sound system that will blow your mind. By night we bring you some of the most talented DJ’s and artists to create an unforgettable experience of movement, sound and performance. By day we host sound healings, deep house yoga, and listening parties of your favorite artists. We also offer bod

The Sultry Lodge.name: The Sultry Lodge
The Sultry Lodge.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Seattle A sultry crowd from 3 continents! # A stunning UV-Black-Light Interactive-Art Exhibition: from Dusk till Dawn. # Lounge & Chill in Gentle Shade: through Sultry Day till Fading Eventide. # Get your hair Braided with colorful extensions: Mon & Tue noon. (** volunteer braiding helpers needed! **) # Sandwiches, Coffee & Tea: Wed late morning. # Make your own jewelry out of colorfu

The Surge.name: The Surge
The Surge.description: Hometown: Phoenix Come charge your small devices at THE SURGE’s bar or living room. Join us for cold-brew coffee, morning meditation, education, conversation in our comfortable living room with a water mister, or grab a tasty brew or shot (or NA cocktail) at our fabulous bar. Join us for our Cancer Survivor circle on Tuesday and Thursday mornings at 11am. Come to our workshop How to become Solar P

THE VEIL.name: THE VEIL
THE VEIL.description: Hometown: Redding Empyrean is an immersive, walk-through theatrical experience that invites you into a mystical journey of beauty, darkness, and transformation. Step inside our atmospheric realms where living art, interactive spirit guides, and cinematic staging surround you in a story you don’t just watch, you walk through. When you emerge, drift into our luminous lounge, a sanctuary to reflect,

The Wastelanders.name: The Wastelanders
The Wastelanders.description: Hometown: Arizona Forged from scavenged tech, glowing mesh, and post industrial grit, this camp pulses with creative chaos.. By day, rogue artists, builders, and hackers gather for connection and playful acts of radical self-expression. By night, the Fire Zone comes alive with performances from local and visiting fire artists. Inside the Tech Noir Bar, wanderers trade stories over chilled drinks i

THICC VIBEZ.name: THICC VIBEZ
THICC VIBEZ.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Topaz We will have a branch from the giving tree art car that we have not used on the at car for sometime now. We will be mounting this 8′ long horizontally arched branch 15′ high off one of our frontage street corners, with 12′ long GREEN vines hanging from the branch blowing in the wind like a flag. It looks just like the art car so people will know what camp we are when the art car

This Is It.name: This Is It
This Is It.description: Hometown: Denver This is a camp serving hot & iced tea with offerings of a phone charging station and ASL conversation. Contact

Three of Cups.name: Three of Cups
Three of Cups.description: Hometown: San Francisco Cmon down to the tarot swamp to get swampy and get tarot’d. Contact

Through the Looking Gl.ass.name: Through the Looking Gl.ass
Through the Looking Gl.ass.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: New York City Ever wondered what it’s like inside a colon? Now’s your chance. Through the Looking Gl.ass is an immersive, walk-through colon exhibit that takes you on a journey through the human digestive tract – complete with glowing lights, and gurgling sounds. Step inside, walk through, and come out the other end with a new perspective on your gut health. Outside the exhibit, leave

tiny camp.name: tiny camp
tiny camp.description: Hometown: Oakland, CA tiny camp is tiny

Titanic.name: Titanic
Titanic.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: SAN FRANCISCO Titanic’s End is taking a year off, and instead, we are building a giant art activation in the Playa. Look for a giant ship where we will host many events. You can also find our builders at camp and with our HUB camps, Bangers Only and Mothership Contact

Titicaca.name: Titicaca
Titicaca.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Los Angeles Come and join us on the mystical shores of the exotic Lake Titicaca and enjoy our mountain hospitality. Contact

Tossed and Sauced.name: Tossed and Sauced
Tossed and Sauced.description: Hometown: Chicago Tossed and Sauced — a few tossers and some fun-loving saucers are making pizza. We will have pizza on three scheduled days and a couple of pop-up parties. Bring good vibes and a napkin.

TOT.name: TOT
TOT.description: Hometown: Phoenix Where people are nice, the swing set is big and where you are welcome. Contact

Totally 80s Disco Aerobic Inferno.name: Totally 80s Disco Aerobic Inferno
Totally 80s Disco Aerobic Inferno.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco, CA Welcome to your one-stop shop for fitness on the playa! Our camp will be offering a variety of fun and interesting classes throughout the week at different times. So whether you’re a morning, midday, or evening fitness person, we’ve got you. We’ll have Pilates, dance classes, themed workouts, and plenty of opportunities to move your body. Come by, shake some ass, and

Touch Glass.name: Touch Glass
Touch Glass.description: Hometown: San Francisco Art support camp creating the 2026 Honoraria piece Kaleidoscope.

Tour de Chance.name: Tour de Chance
Tour de Chance.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco Êtes-vous chanceux? Ride the the Playa’s largest French-themed bicycle-powered carnival game for marvelous prizes! But vélo beware, some are risqué. Contact

TOWER69.name: TOWER69
TOWER69.description: Hometown: Los Angeles A supportive camp for TOWER69 Mutant Vehicle. Hop on board! While we are on duty, you will not drown in the desert of loneliness! Contact

Toxic Disco Clam.name: Toxic Disco Clam
Toxic Disco Clam.description: Hometown: San Francisco In the default world, the Toxic Disco Clam is a real aquatic creature. It uses its luminous lips to attract passing fish… and then it dazes them with acidic snot. We’re pretty much the same: we draw you in with dazzling lights and entertaining activities, we ply you with our intoxicating beverages, and we hope you never leave.

TRANSCEND.name: TRANSCEND
TRANSCEND.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Los Angeles A place to celebrate the sound of electronic music in all of its forms, a place to “TRANCSEND” mind, body and soul using any beat per minute you can imagine. Join us for this musical journey on Tuesday and Thursday afternoons!

Treble Makers.name: Treble Makers
Treble Makers.description: Hometown: San Francisco Long day on playa? With a daily wine, music, and cheese pairing at sunset, you’ll be able to enjoy some of life’s most indulgent pleasures. Our artists are grass-fed, our red wine is selected and served by beret-wearing french busboys, and we will show you the difference between cheese and fu**ng fromage. If you want to get to the next level of indulgence come enjoy the som

Tree of Love.name: Tree of Love
Tree of Love.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Amsterdam Step into a legendary oasis where ancient strength meets modern rhythm. Our camp welcomes all weary travelers to find shade under our monumental tree and dance in the shadow of heroic man and woman warrior statues. Whether you’re looking to catch a high-energy sunset DJ set, admire the prototypes of our open-playa art, or simply cool down with a refreshing drink, we offer a

Turbaza Chayka.name: Turbaza Chayka
Turbaza Chayka.description: Hometown: San Francisco A playful, interactive camp blending vintage aesthetics with irreverent curiosity. Visitors can sip a fine selection of teas while browsing our vintage porn salon, send handwritten postcards through our Post Office of Questionable Taste, and collect stamps or temporary tattoos from the Department of Dubious Markings. Twats Your Gender?.name: Twats Your Gender?
Twats Your Gender?.description: Hometown: San Francisco An LGBTQ led camp inviting participants to explore creativity, identity, and connection through playful interactive experiences. Visitors can screen print personal items with the address of something meaningful and unique to this year’s theme. Guests can also create whimsical insect artwork by stamping marbled paint from their bum to create wings onto a small canvas and add

Twilight language.name: Twilight language
Twilight language.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Bay Area A collective of creators on a mission to realize conceptual visual art and cultivate energy around it. Our passion is to create bold, interactive, innovative, and novel experiences. Or maybe it’s just the world’s best pizza party… Contact

Twisted.name: Twisted
Twisted.description: Hometown: Lake Tahoe A vibrant gathering space where creativity, connection, and community come to life. Our camp features a welcoming bar with mixologists (you never know what drink concoction we might have!), a cozy coffee station, and a lively atmosphere with music by DJ Tokenoshi and live acoustic jam sessions. Twisted Swan Celtic pub.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Albuquerque The Twisted Swan and Bacchus! Come for a calm cool after noon or a nice cold pint at night. Contact

Two Lanterns.name: Two Lanterns
Two Lanterns.description: Hometown: Aptos Best weddings on the playa, with all the trimmings! Department of Wedding Planning is in our camp, consult with the experts. Contact

U.F.O..name: U.F.O.
U.F.O..description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Oakland U.F.O. is an oasis by day to pamper yourself and relax in a cozy, shaded environment with great music. At night we turn up the bass and the fire. Lots of personality

Udder Nonsense.name: Udder Nonsense
Udder Nonsense.description: Hometown: Tahoe Something mysterious has appeared on the playa. A herd of cows, extraterrestrial, or possibly escaped from Fly Ranch, has set up camp, and they want you. Come climb the Milk Tower for panoramic playa views, race mini cow RC cars through our obstacle course, or slip on a pair of cow headphones and lose yourself in the Moo Lounge Rouge silent discow experience. Three times this week

Uli Baba & the Horny Thieves.name: Uli Baba & the Horny Thieves
Uli Baba & the Horny Thieves.description: Hometown: San Diego The Finest Flesh Market in Black Rock City! In addition to the Ten Principles, our guiding inspiration is hospitality. We are always honored to serve our guests, even while subjecting them to cruel humiliation, voluntary servitude, and wanton drunkenness. Our gorgeous Moroccan tent is lushly furnished with wall-to-wall rugs, benches, and more pillows than you can count. Ours is

Uncle Larry\u2019s Misguided Burners.name: Uncle Larry’s Misguided Burners
Uncle Larry\u2019s Misguided Burners.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Murphys Home of KART Radio on 88.3FM! Listen to live music while getting weird on the streets of BRC! Contact

Under the Big Top.name: Under the Big Top
Under the Big Top.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Reno Come visit our camp and enjoy talks and teachings of Qigong energy healing and various other modalities. Relax on the many couches in our chill space with introspective music in the background and fall into some fun and deep conversation about qigong and the meaning of life. Try out some of the dozens of hammocks hanging from an intricate and interesting hammock structure. In the

Unicorner.name: Unicorner
Unicorner.description: Hometown: Dixon, CA A family-friendly haven for creativity, light-hearted fun, sharing, and magic! Come lounge in our stuffy pile and color in the UniDome and get a prescription at the Unicorn Advice Booth interactive installation! Unicorner is created by a crew of hearty shenaniganists who have several goals on the playa: having lots of FUN, spreading lots of LOVE, and championing the 10 Principl

Unitopia.name: Unitopia
Unitopia.description: Hometown: Missoula A welcoming oasis of music, creativity, and connection. Our camp features a large shaded lounge where participants can relax, meet new friends, and enjoy playful daytime gatherings. Throughout the week we host morning yoga, coffee and music sessions, workshops, and our signature Unicorns and Spritz dance party. Our music art car SoGnarwhal occasionally docks at camp for special

UniverseCity.name: UniverseCity
UniverseCity.description: Hometown: San Francisco Welcome to UniverseCity, the prestigious Black Rock City College of Arts and Sciences. Our accredited program issues diplomas on any subject matter, however imaginary. These range from the fictional and unlikely to major changes in life direction. Join us on campus and register at the Admissions Office to receive your Letter of Acceptance. Early in the week, attend New Stud

UnStable.name: UnStable
UnStable.description: ⛺︎ We are a Mutant vehicle Support Camp for an MV named “Chester.” We will be sharing resources and supporting an art support camp called, “Apotheneum.” They are a large scale interactive light and sound installation. Contact

Vagabonds & Tagalongs.name: Vagabonds & Tagalongs
Vagabonds & Tagalongs.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Sacramento A camp for wanderers and wanderlust! Vags and Tags brings together an ever-expanding nationwide community of burners to co-create a space where everyone can feel at home. Come by and see for yourself why we’ve won the official BRC award for best friends on playa since 2012! Contact

Vamp Camp.name: Vamp Camp
Vamp Camp.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Reno Nevada Burning since 1994, one of the oldest camps on playa. We are mostly Battle Born burners whom take pride in Nevada. We enjoy playa lore while sipping our signature Vamp Juice or a cup of joe. Stop by, we do bite! Contact

Vault 21+.name: Vault 21+
Vault 21+.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Denver Vault 21+ invites you to step into our 23-hour-a-day dive bar?that’s right, 23 hours. If you’re roaming the wasteland and thirsting for a drink, there’s a good chance we’re open? unless it’s sunrise. In that case, take a moment to soak in the irradiated sunrise, then return when the time is right. We’ll still be here, with a cold drink waiting for you. This week, we’ve got a ki

VCamp \u2013 Vibrations in the Desert.name: VCamp – Vibrations in the Desert
VCamp \u2013 Vibrations in the Desert.description: Hometown: Los Angeles A unique sound immersion experience designed to relax, ground, and awaken the senses. Our Vibration Lounge features specially designed vibration platforms equipped with built-in subwoofers that emit deep, resonant frequencies, creating full-body vibrations that promote mindfulness and presence. Visitors are invited to pause, tune in, and journey through curated soundscapes th

Venice Red Light.name: Venice Red Light
Venice Red Light.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Venice Beach A roaming tribe of artists, musicians, and delightful weirdos building a playground of sound, art, and human connection. From deep sonic journeys in our dome to unexpected encounters in our lounge, we create a space where strangers become friends (or lovers) and nights stretch into sunrise. Contact

Very Inappropriate People.name: Very Inappropriate People
Very Inappropriate People.description: Hometown: Las Vegas A majority Las Vegas based camp with running daytime saloon events & nightly live music & DJ produced dance events. Upon entrance you might be surprised with special pop-up performances, Vegas style casino games & inappropriate mobsters trying to swindle you into a deal. Also known for famous shenanigans such as VIP bottle service surprise, Deer in headlights are art car stalki

Vibe Check.name: Vibe Check
Vibe Check.description: Hometown: Milwaukee, WI Vibe Check is an oasis on the playa, here to welcome you in with a cold drink and a shady place to take a load off. Pull up for a drink at our swing bar or relax in a hammock while meeting new friends and enjoying good music. Contact

Videogasm.name: Videogasm
Videogasm.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Detroit, MI & Philadelphia, PA Black Rock City’s Playa Theater since 1998! Nightly video screenings on our 20′ screen. Get your morning coffee at our Slurping Sloth Cafe. Body painting every afternoon in our shade structure. Play with our oversized games. Check out the Sleepy Pickle Bar for one of our daily themed happy hours. You Pick it Double Feature chosen by the citizens of BRC (

Vietnamese Iced Coffee Experience.name: Vietnamese Iced Coffee Experience
Vietnamese Iced Coffee Experience.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco VICE is an all inclusive, lgbtq-centric Burning Man Theme Camp returning for the 24th consecutive year to offer cool icy beverages during the heat of the day as well as several other activities for our fellow participants. We encourage diversity, participation, and acceptance and welcome new members from all locales and walks of life. Contact

Vin Et Gare.name: Vin Et Gare
Vin Et Gare.description: Hometown: San Francisco A queer aperitivo camp built around small offerings and shared moments. A shaded lounge by day with tastings, drinks, and conversation. A gathering place by evening where identity, attraction, and curiosity blur together. At night, look for us deep in the playa, where a table appears where it should not be, and a drink is waiting.

Vines Without Borders.name: Vines Without Borders
Vines Without Borders.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco A chill international wine bar and lounge open afternoons and evening daily, gifting great chilled wines and snacks from around the world, served by people from around the world. We celebrate a different wine producing region daily. Great music, fun people, curated tastings and something new every day. Contact

Vitruvian.name: Vitruvian
Vitruvian.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Los Angeles Turn your world upside down at Vitruvian Lounge. Enjoy good gyrations by taking a spin on our Human Sized Gyroscope, and stay to enjoy good vibrations in our lounge with great music and ice cold craft cocktails. Head into the K-Box for Korean-style private room karaoke to sing the night away together from 9pm to sunrise. Contact

Vivarium.name: Vivarium
Vivarium.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Washington, D.C. Step into a playful, welcoming front porch living room where conversation, comfort, and curiosity come first. Expect a mix of sensory delights, language lessons, music jams, whiskey and bad advice, and late-night grilled cheese hospitality. This is a camp for lingering, laughing, learning something unexpected, and connecting with strangers who may not stay strangers f

Vomiting Sparrows.name: Vomiting Sparrows
Vomiting Sparrows.description: Hometown: Portland We serve the best Bloody Mary on the playa. We entertain, we make friends, we make fun, we welcome all. Keep an eye and ear open for our special events. Chirp Chirp Blarf!

VW Bus Camp.name: VW Bus Camp
VW Bus Camp.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Tucson You are heartily invited to camp and participate with VW Bus Camp for Axis Mundi arriving on the Playa in an old VW Bus or other unique camper. VW Bus Camp is a wonderful and enduring Burning Man theme camp which has been placed and participated on the Playa every Burn since 1998. First, make sure to change out your leaky fuel lines, check your tires, carry a fire extinguisher

Waffles & House.name: Waffles & House
Waffles & House.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Oakland We serve up delicious Waffles, with all your favorite toppings, ice cold drinks, and bumping House music for your dancing pleasure all week long! Don’t forget to come by on Friday for a syrup licking good time, as that’s when we host our world-famous Waffolympics! Contact

Wally\u2019s Cowboy Kitchen.name: Wally’s Cowboy Kitchen
Wally\u2019s Cowboy Kitchen.description: Hometown: Houston Interactive cooking camp for people to learn camp cooking and have a hot meal. Great place to hang out. Contact

Wanderlust.name: Wanderlust
Wanderlust.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Reno Welcome to our Moroccan Themed Oasis in the Desert. Come join us for our fun activities. We look forward to seeing you on the Playa!!!

Wasted Sunshine.name: Wasted Sunshine
Wasted Sunshine.description: Hometown: San Diego Frozen Lemonade FOR ALL AGES! Fantastic insults! Booze for consenting adults. AC Lounge chill zone.

Water Suckers.name: Water Suckers
Water Suckers.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco A welcoming bar and lounge camp with music, dancing, and a shaded space to gather on the playa. Our core interactivity is an open portrait and live sketch experience for the Black Rock City community, where passersby can sit for a quick portrait, share a story, strike a pose, or co-create a moment through drawing. This includes the delivery logistics of large water deliveries on playa to infrastructure, honorarium art, and theme camps with interactive water usage. Our office can be found on Esplanade at 5:20 between HEaT and Moop Map HQ. Contact

Wetspot.name: Wetspot
Wetspot.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: Reno Established in 2010 and based in Reno, NV, Wetspot is a playa favorite saloon for daytime fun and libations. White Elephant Exchange.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco The White Elephant Exchange is a waypoint for roving pachyderms from all eras, generations, and originations to gather. Come by to find the Funkadelephant and its growing family, or come find us roaming the wide open Playa.

Wok Paper Scissors.description: Hometown: Los Angeles Welcome to Wok Paper Scissors! Here in Sizzle City you battle for your stir fry. Come one, come all to Wok Paper Scissors, serving stir fry on the playa daily. To get your hands on a bowl of our delicious delights, you must first win a game of rock-paper-scissors! Do you have what it takes when noodles are at stake?

Wonder Camp.description: Hometown: Tacoma The Department of Wonder is our on-playa bike shop. We offer bike repair service and education every day of the event through man-burn. Contact

Word Play Cafe.name: Word Play Cafe
Word Play Cafe.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: San Francisco Word Play Cafe is the space at Burning Man dedicated entirely to word games for people to gather, play and learn together. Visitors to Word Play Cafe can play favorite daily games, classic word games, and custom games like our Burning Man themed crossword, and other new word games we created just for Burning Man in our 30 ft dome. Worst Bar.description: Hometown: Los Angeles, CA Drink Shit and Die: Worst Bar gifts experiences in the form of beverages/rituals during our scheduled Unhappy Hours. The consensual experiences are not pleasurable in the expected sense and include but are not limited to mild or moderate elements of pain, humiliation, embarrassment, and disgust or combinations thereof.

WrongoWrongo.name: WrongoWrongo
WrongoWrongo.description: Hometown: Cleveland The home of the mutant vehicle Uuna Ahi and your somewhat friendly neighborhood mutant vehicle repair oasis. Contact

X marks the spot.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: OrangeVale The place where the treasures of family and friends are found. We camp together to enjoy a week of sharing, creativity and beauty. We gather here to reconnect with old friends and make new friends. We like being a small part of this huge community.

XOXO.name: XOXO
XOXO.description: Hometown: San Francisco Welcome to your oasis on the playa! Xpat Alien.name: Xpat Alien
Xpat Alien.description: ⛺︎ Hometown: denver Xpat Alien has searched far and wide, through many galaxies, to find a new place to rest our travel weary heads. Earth fits the bill and we have decided to stay. XXX-MAS.description: Hometown: Midland XXXmas! Y Knot Saloon.description: Hometown: San Francisco A late 1800s western town with a saloon on wheels, an apothecary, and a water tower. Come for a refreshing beverage, views, and live music.

Yaass Daddy!.description: Hometown: Seattle Art support camp for Canis Minor

Yabba Dabba Do Me.name: Yabba Dabba Do Me
Yabba Dabba Do Me.description: Hometown: Reno eNVy Celebrating 30 years on the playa, the return of Yabba Dabba Do Me, a trampoline suspended from a giant net of bungee cords. Yellow Balloon.name: Yellow Balloon
Yellow Balloon.description: Hometown: Oakland A clean and sober camp, offering a space for fun, connection, and wellness without the influence of substances. Our camp is a vibrant community of burners who love to have a great time while staying clean and sober throughout the burn. We welcome all

Yellow Bike Project.name: Yellow Bike Project
Yellow Bike Project.description: Home of the Yellow Bike Project. Please bring all Yellow Bikes in need of repair here. We will be fixing them for release back into the city. Remember not to hoard, decorate/alter, or take home Yellow Bikes . Yellow Bikes are not to be inside any camp at any time. SHARE them.

Yes Please.name: Yes Please

You Light Up My Ride is here to help and inspire you to fabulously light up your rig! Come visit us to get your bike better lit up and stay for a while and share a deep laugh or two.

You Look Amazing.name: You Look Amazing
You Look Amazing.description: Hometown: Hermosa Beach You Look Amazing is not just a camp name, but a state of mind. We LOVE each and everyone of you and want to get to know you better. Your New Friend.name: Your New Friend
